name: Dawn

targetAreaEffect.value: All creatures in a 15-ft.-radius burst centered on you

description: All sleeping creatures in a 15-ft.-radius burst centered on you awaken. Those unconscious from nonlethal damage wake up staggered. Does not affect dying creatures. Fortitude negates (harmless); SR yes (harmless).

name: Naturewatch
description: Functions like deathwatch but only on plants and animals in a cone-shaped emanation. Also reveals other mundane health information, such as whether plants are dehydrated or animals malnourished.

name: Animate Fire
description: Animates a campfire-sized Small fire into a creature with the statistics of a Small fire elemental (MM 98), which attacks as you direct. It cannot move beyond the fire's range (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels) from its source. Concentration, up to 1 round/level. Material component: charcoal, sulfur, and soda ash.

name: Animate Water

targetAreaEffect.value: Cube of water up to 5 ft. on a side

description: Functions like animate fire, but animates at least 4 cubic feet of water into a Small water elemental (MM 100) instead. Material component: a vial of spring water mixed with cinnabar oil.

name: Animate Wood

targetAreaEffect.value: One Small or smaller wooden object

description: Imbues a touched Small or smaller wooden object with mobility, causing it to immediately attack the creature you designate. Uses the statistics of a Small animated object (MM 13) with hardness 5. Cannot animate objects carried or worn by a creature. Concentration, up to 1 round/level. Material component: powdered cinnabar and ground peach pit.

name: Aspect of the Wolf
description: You take on the physical form and many qualities of a wolf (MM 283) for 10 minutes/level. Your type becomes animal, size Medium, space/reach 5 ft./5 ft. You gain wolf ability scores (Str 13, Dex 15, Con 15) while keeping your own mental scores, base land speed becomes 50 ft., and you gain low-light vision, scent, and a primary bite attack (1d6+1). Natural armor becomes +2 regardless of your normal form's bonus, and you gain the wolf's free trip attempt on a successful bite. Class, level, HP, alignment, BAB, and base saves are unchanged. You lose your own Ex/Sp/Su abilities (but keep class-derived extraordinary special attacks like rage or sneak attack) and cannot speak or cast spells unless you have Natural Spell. Equipment melds into the new form and becomes nonfunctional. Arcane material component: a wolf's whisker.

name: Aura Against Flame
description: Creates a blue mist aura for 1 round/level that grants resist energy (fire) 10, as the spell. Any nonmagical flame dealing 10 or fewer points of maximum damage per round (torches, small fires, thrown alchemist's fire) that touches the aura is snuffed out, dealing no damage to you. As a standard action you may touch an existing magical fire effect (e.g. flaming sphere, wall of fire) and attempt to dispel it as a dispel magic effect using your caster level; success negates the fire's damage and ends both effects, failure means you take reduced damage and both effects persist. As a readied action, you can use the aura to counterspell a magical fire attack against you in the same way.

name: Babau Slime
description: Coats the touched creature's skin, armor, and equipment in a slimy red layer for 1 minute/level. Any creature that strikes the subject with an unarmed strike, touch attack (including touch spells), or natural weapon takes 1d8 points of acid damage. Any creature grappling the subject takes 1d8 acid damage at the start of its turn. Harmless; Fortitude negates, SR yes. Material component: a drop of babau slime.

name: Beast Claws
description: Grants two claw attacks for 1 hour/level, each dealing 1d4 slashing damage with a 19-20 threat range and provoking no attack of opportunity. You may make a single claw attack or a full attack with both claws at your normal attack bonus in place of your regular attack routine, with no two-weapon fighting penalty and neither claw treated as secondary. If your base attack bonus is +6 or higher you gain no extra iterative attacks, only the two claws at full bonus. Attacking with a manufactured weapon or another natural attack that round precludes claw attacks. Does not impair manual dexterity or spellcasting. Material component: the claw of a bird of prey.

name: Beastland Ferocity
description: The touched creature fights without penalty even while disabled or dying, for 1 minute/level. While at -1 to -9 hit points it gains a +4 enhancement bonus to Strength; it still dies normally upon reaching -10 hp. Harmless; Fortitude negates, SR yes.

name: Beget Bogun
description: Creates a Tiny construct servant called a bogun (alignment matching the creator: N, CN, LN, NE, or NG). Stats: Init +3, darkvision 60 ft. and low-light vision, AC 15 (touch 15, flat-footed 12), 11 hp (2 HD), Fort +0/Ref +3/Will +1, speed 20 ft. and fly 50 ft. (good), nettles melee attack +1 (1d4-2 plus poison, DC 11, 1d6 Dex/1d6 Dex), Str 7/Dex 16/Con -/Int 8/Wis 13/Cha 10, construct traits, Stealthy feat, Hide +10/Move Silently +9. The bogun shares its creator's alignment and is telepathically linked to it (sharing sight/hearing) up to 500 yards, and won't willingly leave that range. It carries out simple tasks (attacking, carrying messages, opening doors) but, being self-aware, refuses a task 5% of the time; the creator can attempt a DC 11 Diplomacy check to convince it, with failure meaning it does the opposite or refuses entirely for 24 hours. It cannot speak. Requires XP and a material component.

name: Branch to Branch
description: For 1 hour/level (D), grants a +10 competence bonus on Climb checks made in trees. While at least 10 feet above the ground you can brachiate through medium or dense forest (not sparse forest), gaining a +10 ft. enhancement bonus to land speed and ignoring hampered-movement penalties from undergrowth and similar terrain while doing so. You can charge but not run while brachiating. Breaks in the canopy (clearings, wide rivers, sparse forest) may force you back to the ground.

name: Breath of the Jungle

targetAreaEffect.value: Mist spreads in a 40-ft. radius, 20 ft. high

description: Creates a foul mist spreading 40 ft. radius, 20 ft. high, lasting 1 minute/level. Any saving throw against poison or disease made within the mist has its DC increased by 2. The mist provides no concealment.

name: Buoyant Lifting

targetAreaEffect.value: One willing creature/ level, no two of which are more than 20 ft. apart

description: Cast as an immediate action, this spell bears up to one willing creature per level (no two more than 20 ft. apart) toward the surface of a liquid at 60 feet per round until they float, rescuing a sinking air-breather from drowning. The subject then floats and can swim away or be towed. The spell ends for a subject if it is removed from the liquid. Duration 1 minute/level (D), see text.

name: Camouflage
description: For 10 minutes/level, your skin and clothing automatically shift color to match any new surroundings you enter with no effort on your part, granting a +10 circumstance bonus on Hide checks.

name: Claws of the Bear
description: For 1 round/level, your hands become natural weapons dealing 1d8 damage each (1d6 if you are Small, 2d6 if Large) or your normal unarmed damage, whichever is greater; you're considered armed and add your Strength modifier to damage. You may make a single claw attack or a full attack with both claws at your normal attack bonus in place of your regular routine, with no two-weapon fighting penalty and neither claw treated as secondary. If your base attack bonus is +6 or higher, you gain no extra iterative attacks, only the two claws at full bonus.

name: Cloudburst
description: Summons heavy rain in a 100-ft.-radius emanation for 10 minutes/level. Halves visibility range (-4 penalty on Spot and Search checks), automatically extinguishes unprotected flames, and has a 50% chance to extinguish protected flames. Ranged attacks and Listen checks take a -4 penalty, and fire damage in the area is reduced by 1 point per damage die. Doesn't function indoors, underground, underwater, or in deserts. The created water evaporates over 10 minutes after the spell ends and doesn't slake thirst or nourish plants.

name: Cold Fire

targetAreaEffect.value: One ﬁre source (up to a 20-ft. cube) or one creature; see text

description: Turns the flames of a targeted fire source (up to a 20-ft. cube, including sufficiently small magical fires like a wall of fire) into blue-white cold flames that deal cold damage instead of fire damage to anything they contact, for 1 minute/level (D); no save, SR no. Alternatively, targeted at a creature with the fire subtype or vulnerability to cold, it instantly deals 1d6 points of cold damage per two caster levels (maximum 5d6) with no other effect; Fortitude half, SR yes.

name: Crabwalk
description: For 1 minute/level, when the touched creature charges it gains a +4 bonus on the attack roll and takes no penalty to Armor Class, replacing the normal +2 attack/-2 AC charge modifiers. If the creature can make multiple attacks after charging (such as with pounce), the bonus applies only to the first attack. Material component: a crab's leg.

name: Deep Breath
description: Cast as an immediate action, your lungs instantly fill with air and continue refilling for 1 round/level; once the duration ends you can continue holding your breath as if you had just taken a full breath. Fast enough to cast to save yourself from drowning after being suddenly plunged into water.

name: Delay Disease
description: Touch spell that halts the progress of a nonmagical disease already afflicting the target for 24 hours. The subject skips its required saving throw against the disease for the day (counting as neither success nor failure for recovery purposes) and takes no further ability damage from it during that time. The incubation period of any new disease the subject is exposed to during the spell's duration doesn't begin until the spell expires. It does not cure damage the disease has already dealt and has no effect on magical or supernatural diseases.

name: Enrage Animal
description: Affects one creature of the animal type at medium range (100 ft. + 10 ft./level), lasting for concentration + 1 round. Grants a +4 morale bonus to Strength and Constitution, a +2 morale bonus on Will saves, and a -2 penalty to AC, functioning like a barbarian's rage (PH 25), except the animal is not fatigued when it ends.

name: Foundation of Stone

targetAreaEffect.value: One creature/level, no two of which are more than 30 ft. apart

description: Close-range spell (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels) affecting one creature per level, no two more than 30 ft. apart, lasting 1 round/level. As long as the subjects remain stationary on solid ground, they gain a +2 bonus to AC and a +4 bonus on Strength checks to resist being bull rushed or tripped; in mountainous terrain the Strength check bonus increases to +6.

name: Hawkeye
description: Personal-range spell lasting 10 minutes/level (dismissible). Increases the caster's range increment for ranged weapons by 50% and grants a +5 competence bonus on Spot checks.

name: Healthful Rest

targetAreaEffect.value: One creature/level, no two of which are more than 30 ft. apart

description: Close-range spell (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels) affecting up to one creature per level, no two more than 30 ft. apart, lasting 24 hours (Will negates, harmless). Doubles the subjects' natural healing rate: each affected creature regains twice the hit points and ability damage it would normally regain that day, based on its activity level (PH 76).

name: Horrible Taste
description: Touch spell (material component: a pinch of rotten meat) lasting 10 minutes/level. Any creature that bites the touched creature or object must succeed on a Fortitude save or be nauseated until the end of its next turn. A creature of animal Intelligence (2 or lower) that fails will not willingly bite the subject again; forcing it to try requires a Handle Animal check as if "pushing" the animal, made each time. Creatures immune to poison or unable to taste are unaffected.

name: Low-light Vision
description: Touch spell (arcane material component: a small candle) lasting 1 hour/level, Will negates (harmless). Grants the touched creature low-light vision.

name: Omen of Peril
description: Personal spell (1 round casting time, instantaneous, requires a focus of marked sticks, bones, or similar tokens worth at least 25 gp) that grants a brief vision of the danger level of the caster's next hour of travel: safety, peril, or great danger, in a form shaped by the caster's faith or philosophy. Base chance of an accurate vision is 70% + 1%/caster level (max 90%), rolled secretly by the DM; on failure the caster receives one of the other two results at random and has no way of knowing it's inaccurate. Unlike augury, it answers no specific question and indicates only overall danger level, not its nature.

name: Raging Flame
description: Medium-range spell (100 ft. + 10 ft./level) creating a 30-ft.-radius spread lasting 1 minute. All normal fires in the area burn twice as hot and bright (double illumination radius, e.g. a torch sheds bright light in 40 ft.; double fire damage, e.g. 2d6/round from catching fire) but burn out in half the normal time; fire that leaves the area remains affected. Magical fire in the area (e.g. produce flame, fireball) deals +1 fire damage per die. Counters or dispels slow burn.

name: Ram’s Might
description: Personal spell lasting 1 minute/level. Grants a +2 enhancement bonus to Strength and causes the caster's unarmed strikes to deal lethal instead of nonlethal damage while counting as armed. No other effect; spellcasting and object manipulation are unimpaired.

name: Rapid Burrowing
description: Touch spell lasting 10 minutes/level, Fortitude negates (harmless). Increases the touched creature's burrow speed by 20 feet. Has no effect on other movement modes and does not grant a burrow speed, or the ability to burrow through stone, to a creature that doesn't already have it.

name: Remove Scent
description: Touch spell (material component: a pinch of unscented candle wax) lasting 10 minutes/level, Will negates. Hides the scent of the touched creature or object so the scent ability (MM 314) cannot detect it, and negates the harmful effects of noxious stenches exuded by certain creatures (such as ghasts) for the duration.

name: Resist Planar Alignment
description: Touch spell lasting 10 minutes/level, Fortitude negates (harmless). Grants the subject limited protection from a plane's alignment traits (DMG 149): while on a plane with an alignment trait, the subject becomes immune to Charisma-based check penalties that mildly aligned planes impose on visitors of opposed alignment, and the Charisma-, Wisdom-, and Intelligence-based check penalties imposed by strongly aligned planes are halved for the duration.

name: Sandblast
description: Creates a 10-ft.-radius burst centered on the caster (range 10 ft.), instantaneous, Reflex half. Creatures in the area take 1d6 points of nonlethal damage, and any creature that fails its Reflex save is also stunned for 1 round. The caster is unaffected.

name: Slow Burn
description: Medium-range spell (100 ft. + 10 ft./level) creating a 30-ft.-radius spread lasting 1 minute (arcane material component: an oil-filled hourglass). Existing fires in the area burn twice as long at the same intensity but their illumination radius is halved. They become harder to extinguish: it takes twice as long to put one out, and if extinguishing requires a roll (such as a Reflex save to put out a creature on fire), two successful rolls over 2 rounds are needed, with a failed roll resetting progress. Magical fire in the area (e.g. produce flame, fireball) deals 1 less fire damage per die. Counters or dispels raging flame.

name: Snake’s Swiftness
description: Close-range spell (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels) affecting one allied creature, instantaneous, Will negates (harmless), arcane material component: a few snake scales. The subject can immediately make one melee or ranged attack without altering its place in the initiative order, following normal attack rules. Only a single extra attack is granted; the spell fails if the subject has already gained an extra attack that round from a prior casting of this spell, haste, or any other source.

name: Snowshoes
description: Touch spell lasting 1 hour/level (dismissible), Will negates (harmless). The subject can walk over ice and snow without its speed being reduced, gains a +10-foot enhancement bonus to speed, and needs no Balance check or Reflex save to avoid slipping and falling, cracking ice it walks on, or falling through cracked ice. It also leaves no more noticeable a trail through ice and snow than on solid ground, denying trackers any bonus from following it.

name: Surefooted Stride
description: Personal spell lasting 1 minute/level. The caster can move through difficult terrain at full speed, and can run, charge, and tumble through it as though it were clear terrain. Also grants a +2 competence bonus on Climb checks.

name: Thunderhead
description: Close-range spell (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels) affecting one creature, lasting 1 round/level (material component: a small piece of copper wire). Creates a small thundercloud over the subject's head that follows it unerringly even if it turns invisible or leaves the area. Each round, a miniature lightning bolt leaps from the cloud to strike the subject for 1 point of electricity damage, negated by a successful Reflex save.

name: Traveler’s Mount
description: Touch spell affecting an animal or magical beast, lasting 1 hour/level, Will negates. Grants the mount a +20-foot enhancement bonus to speed and lets it hustle without taking damage or becoming fatigued for the duration. While bearing a rider, the mount no longer attacks in combat during that time -- it still willingly carries its rider into battle, it simply cannot use its own natural weapons.

name: Updraft
description: A swift-action spell that conjures a vortex of rushing air beneath you, propelling you upward 10 feet per caster level. You then gently float back down to the ground, and at any point during the descent you can move up to 5 feet laterally. Material component: a miniature propeller or windmill.

name: Vigor, Lesser
description: Touch spell granting the subject fast healing 1, healing 1 hit point per round until the spell ends and automatically stabilizing it if it begins dying from hit point loss during that time. Lasts 10 rounds + 1 round/level (maximum 15 rounds). Does not restore hit points lost to starvation, thirst, or suffocation, and does not regrow or reattach lost body parts. Multiple vigor effects don't stack; only the highest-level one applies. Will negates (harmless), SR yes (harmless).

name: Vine Strike
description: Personal spell lasting 1 round. While active, you can deliver sneak attacks against plant creatures as though they were not immune to sneak attacks, provided you still meet all the normal requirements for a sneak attack. This applies only to sneak attack damage — it does not let you score critical hits against plants or bypass their damage reduction or other defenses.

name: Wall of Smoke

targetAreaEffect.value: A straight wall whose area is up to one 10-ft. square/level (S)

description: Creates a stationary wall of black smoke up to one 10-ft. square per level. It blocks sight, granting concealment between creatures on opposite sides who can't see over it. A creature passing through the wall must succeed on a Fortitude save or be nauseated for 1 round. A moderate wind (11+ mph, such as gust of wind) destroys the wall in 1 round. Does not function underwater.

name: Wings of the Sea
description: Touch spell lasting 1 minute/level that increases the subject's swim speed by 30 feet. It has no effect on other movement modes and does not grant a swim speed to a creature that lacks one. Fortitude negates (harmless), SR yes (harmless). Material component: a drop of water.

name: Winter Chill
description: Ranged (close) spell against one creature. Target must succeed on a Fortitude save or take 1d6 points of cold damage and become fatigued. Creatures immune to cold are unaffected. Instantaneous, SR yes.

name: Wood Wose
description: Creates a translucent green nature spirit within close range that performs simple natural tasks for you — building a campfire, gathering herbs, feeding an animal companion, catching fish, or similar tasks not involving knowledge of technology (it cannot, for example, work a latch). It performs one activity at a time and repeats it if so commanded, continuing even while you attend to other things, as long as it stays in range. It has an effective Strength of 2 (can lift 20 lb., drag 100 lb.) and can trigger traps, though not most pressure plates. Land speed 15 ft., fly speed 15 ft. (perfect). It cannot attack and is never allowed an attack roll or saving throw; it can't be killed but dissipates if it takes 6 points of damage from an area attack, and ceases to exist if sent beyond the spell's range measured from your current position. Duration 1 hour/level.

name: Align Fang
description: Touch spell lasting 1 minute/level that makes a living creature's natural weapons good-, evil-, lawful-, or chaotic-aligned (caster's choice), allowing them to overcome the damage reduction of creatures vulnerable to that alignment (typically opposed outsiders). Has no effect on a natural weapon already treated as aligned (such as most demons' claws or bite). Cannot be cast on manufactured weapons. Casting it to grant a given alignment makes align fang itself a spell of that alignment (good/evil/lawful/chaotic). Will negates (harmless), SR yes (harmless).

name: Avoid Planar Effects

targetAreaEffect.value: One creature/level in a 20-ft.-radius burst centered on you

description: Immediate-action spell affecting one creature per level within a 20-ft.-radius burst centered on you, lasting 1 minute/level. Grants temporary protection from a plane's inherent natural hazards (per DMG p.150): protects against the 3d10 fire damage from a fire-dominant plane, allows breathing water on a water-dominant plane, ignores suffocation on an earth-dominant plane, prevents blinding from a major positive-dominant plane's energy and caps temporary hit points gained there at your full normal hit points, and prevents negative-dominant planes from dealing damage or bestowing negative levels. It can also negate specific named planar hazards the DM designates (e.g., Pandemonium's deafening effect, cold damage on Cania) and the DM may extend it to other planes such as a homebrew Elemental Plane of Cold. It does not negate gravity, alignment, or magic traits, nor the entrapping trait of planes like Elysium or Hades, and it provides no protection against creatures, spells, special abilities, or nonnatural hazards (e.g., walking into magma). SR yes (harmless).

otherPrintings.note: Planar Handbook's casting time is 1 standard action; Spell Compendium updates it to 1 immediate action.

name: Balancing Lorecall
description: Personal spell lasting 1 minute/level (dismissible) granting a +4 insight bonus on Balance checks, and letting you attempt to balance on an otherwise-impossible surface with a DC 20 Balance check if you have sufficient ranks. With 5+ ranks in Balance, you can balance on vertical surfaces (ignoring the normal slope/angle modifier, though other modifiers like slipperiness still apply), moving up or down as if climbing while still making attacks normally and retaining your Dex bonus to AC, following Balance rules rather than Climb rules. With 10+ ranks, you can balance on liquids, mud, snow, or similar surfaces that normally couldn't support your weight; the DC increases by 5 for each consecutive round you remain balanced there, and you move at half speed unless you accept a further +5 DC to move at normal speed. Arcane material component: a thin, 3-inch wooden dowel.

name: Binding Winds
description: Ranged (medium) spell against one creature, lasting as long as you concentrate. The subject can act normally but cannot move from its location; the winds carry its voice away (it can speak but not be heard) and it can hear nothing but the wind's roar. Casting a spell while bound requires a Concentration check (DC = this spell's save DC + the level of the spell being cast). No sonic or language-dependent spells or effects can pass into or out of the winds, though spells you cast on yourself work normally. Ranged attacks made into or out of the winds take a -2 penalty. The spell holds flying creatures in midair. Reflex negates, SR yes.

name: Bite of the Wererat
description: Personal transmutation lasting 1 round/level. Grants a +6 enhancement bonus to Dexterity, +2 enhancement to Constitution, and +3 enhancement to natural armor. You grow a ratlike snout and gain a bite attack dealing 1d4 damage (1d3 if Small) plus 1-1/2 times your Strength modifier, along with the benefit of Weapon Finesse. If your base attack bonus is +6 or higher, you gain no additional attacks from the bite. Material component: a rat's tail.

name: Blinding Spittle
description: You make a ranged touch attack (at a -4 penalty) to spit caustic saliva into a target's eyes within close range. On a hit, the subject is blinded until it spends a standard action washing its eyes with water or another rinsing fluid. Has no effect on creatures without eyes or that don't rely on eyesight. Instantaneous, SR yes.

name: Blood Frenzy

targetAreaEffect.value: Any creature with the rage ability

description: Touch spell targeting any creature with a rage ability, causing it to enter a rage as per its own rage ability, without using up one of its daily rage attempts. Will negates, SR yes.

name: Body of the Sun
description: Causes fire to radiate 5 feet in all directions from your body for 1 round/level, illuminating the area and dealing 1d4 points of fire damage per two caster levels (maximum 5d4) each round on your turn to adjacent creatures. Reflex half, SR yes.

name: Brambles
description: Touch spell lasting 1 round/level that causes a wooden melee weapon to sprout thorn-like spikes. The weapon deals both piercing and bludgeoning damage, gains a +1 enhancement bonus on attack rolls, and a +1 enhancement bonus per caster level (maximum +10) on melee damage rolls. Works only on melee weapons with wooden striking surfaces — not bows, arrows, or metal weapons like a mace. Material component: a small thorn.

name: Briar Web
description: Causes plants in a 40-ft.-radius spread to grow thorns and entangle creatures for 1 minute/level. The area becomes difficult terrain, halving movement speed within it, and any creature moving through takes 1 point of nonmagical piercing damage per 5 feet moved. Creatures with freedom of movement or woodland stride are unaffected.

name: Burrow
description: Touch spell lasting 1 minute/level (dismissible) that lets the subject burrow through earth and loose rock (not solid stone) at a speed of 30 feet, reduced to 20 feet if wearing medium or heavy armor or carrying a medium or heavy load. Will negates (harmless), SR yes (harmless). Arcane focus: a claw from a burrowing creature.

name: Camouflage, Mass

targetAreaEffect.value: Any number of creatures, no two of which are more than 60 ft. apart

description: Affects any number of creatures within medium range, no two more than 60 feet apart, for 10 minutes/level. Functions like camouflage but moves with the group; the effect breaks for any individual who moves more than 60 feet from the nearest other affected creature (with pairs, whoever moves away loses the effect, or both lose it if they move apart from each other past 60 feet). Will negates (harmless), SR yes (harmless).

name: Cloud Wings
description: Touch spell lasting 1 hour/level that increases the subject's fly speed by 30 feet. It has no effect on other movement modes and does not grant flight to a creature that cannot already fly. Fortitude negates (harmless), SR yes (harmless).

name: Countermoon
description: Chains of energy wrap around a lycanthrope target, forcing it back into its natural form and preventing it from changing shape for the duration—both voluntary alternate-form shapechanging and involuntary lycanthropic transformation. Will negates. Duration 12 hours. Material component: a hair, scale, or other cast-off item from the type of creature.

name: Creeping Cold
description: Turns the target's sweat to ice, dealing cumulative cold damage over 3 rounds: 1d6 the first round, 2d6 the second, 3d6 the third. Only one Fortitude save is allowed, made when the spell is cast; success halves the damage each round instead of negating it. Requires a focus: a small glass or pottery vessel (worth at least 25 gp) filled with ice, snow, or water.

name: Daggerspell Stance
description: A swift-action spell lasting 1 round/level. While wielding a dagger in each hand and making a full attack, you gain a +2 insight bonus on attack and damage rolls with the daggers that round. While wielding two daggers and fighting defensively, you gain spell resistance equal to 5 + your caster level. While wielding two daggers and using total defense, you gain that same spell resistance plus damage reduction 5/magic. Requires a focus: a pair of daggers.

name: Decomposition

targetAreaEffect.value: Living enemies within a 50-ft.- radius emanation centered on you

description: Living enemies within a 50-ft.-radius emanation centered on you who take normal (non-nonlethal) damage suffer an additional 3 points of festering damage at the start of their turn each round thereafter for the spell's duration. A DC 15 Heal check or any cure spell/healing magic stops the festering. Only one wound festers at a time; further wounds taken while one festers don't add new festering. Once festering stops, any new wound taken later while still in the area restarts the process. Duration 1 round/level.

name: Earthbind
description: Hinders a target creature's ability to fly (natural or magical) for the duration. If it fails a Fortitude save, its fly speed becomes 0 feet, and if airborne it descends safely as though under feather fall. Any new effect that would grant flight is suppressed for the spell's duration. Has no effect on other movement types or on airborne movement that doesn't grant an actual fly speed (jumping, levitate, air walk). Duration 1 minute/level (dismissible).

name: Earthen Grace
description: Touch a living creature to grant an affinity for earth and stone: for the duration, damage from stone/earthen sources (natural attacks from creatures of earth or stone, stone weapons, falling onto rock or earth) counts as nonlethal instead of lethal. The effect ends once the nonlethal damage taken (from any source) equals the subject's current hit points, after which further stone/earth damage becomes lethal again. Will negates (harmless); duration 1 minute/level. Material component: a chunk of granite.

name: Earthfast

targetAreaEffect.value: One stone structure or rock formation, up to 25 cubic ft./level

description: Reinforces one stone structure or rock formation (up to 25 cubic ft./level), doubling its hit points and raising its hardness to 10. Instantaneous effect; does not work on constructs.

name: Easy Trail
description: Pushes aside undergrowth in the spell's area (including where you stand) so anyone passing through treats trackless terrain as having a trail. Also increases the DC to track anyone who moved through the area by 5. Has no effect on plant creatures. Ends when the spell's duration expires, at which point the plants return to normal.

name: Embrace the Wild
description: Grants you the senses of an animal: low-light vision, plus your choice of blindsense out to 30 feet or scent, along with a +2 bonus on Listen and Spot checks. Duration 10 minutes/level (dismissible).

name: Fins to Feet
description: Touch a willing creature to transform its tail, tentacles, or fins into humanoid legs and feet. The subject loses any natural swim speed and gains a land speed instead (30 ft. for Medium, 20 ft. for Small or smaller, 40 ft. for Large or larger), and loses any natural attacks based on the transformed tail or tentacles. Fortitude negates (harmless); duration 1 hour/level.

name: Frost Breath
description: A 30-ft. cone-shaped burst of cold dealing 1d4 points of cold damage per two caster levels (maximum 5d4), Reflex half. Creatures that fail the save are also dazed for 1 round. Instantaneous. Material component: three drops of water or ice fragments blown from a cupped palm.

name: Healing Lorecall
description: A caster with 5 or more ranks in Heal can, when casting a conjuration (healing) spell, also remove one of the following conditions from the target: dazed, dazzled, or fatigued. With 10 or more ranks, exhausted, nauseated, or sickened can also be chosen. Additionally, when determining how much a conjuration (healing) spell heals, you may substitute your Heal ranks for your caster level (normal per-spell caster level caps for healing still apply). Duration 10 minutes/level. Material component: a mint leaf.

name: Healing Sting
description: On a successful melee touch attack, deals 1d12 points of damage +1 per caster level (maximum 1d12+10) to a living creature, and you gain an equal number of hit points—capped at your normal full hit point total, with any excess lost. Instantaneous. Material component: five dried wasp bodies.

name: Heartfire

targetAreaEffect.value: Living creatures within a 5-ft.- radius burst

description: Living creatures in a 5-ft.-radius burst are outlined in flame for 1 round/level, shedding light like a torch and losing the benefit of concealment from darkness (though 3rd-level+ magical darkness still works normally), blur, displacement, invisibility, or similar effects. Affected creatures that fail a Fortitude save also take 1d4 points of fire damage each round; success halves the damage each round (minimum 1). Spellcasters taking this damage must make a Concentration check (DC 10 + half the continuous damage last dealt) to cast spells. Extinguishing the fire by normal means ends the outlining effect early.

name: Kelpstrand

targetAreaEffect.value: One creature/3 levels, no two of which are more than 30 ft. apart

description: Make a ranged touch attack against each of up to one target per 3 caster levels (no two more than 30 ft. apart). On a hit, immediately make a free opposed grapple check against that target (using your caster level + Wisdom bonus instead of Strength/size), without provoking attacks of opportunity; you are not considered grappling yourself. On success the target becomes entangled and grappled by the kelp strand and must beat the same grapple check (via grapple or Escape Artist) each round to escape; no action is needed from you to maintain it. Multiple kelpstrands on one target each require separate escape checks. Casting within 300 feet of an ocean shore grants a +4 bonus on kelpstrand grapple checks. Duration 1 round/level. Material component: a piece of dried seaweed.

name: Listening Lorecall
description: Grants a +4 insight bonus on Listen checks. If you have 5 or more ranks in Listen, you also gain blindsense out to 30 feet; with 12 or more ranks, blindsight out to 15 feet instead. A silence effect negates the blindsense/blindsight granted by this spell. Duration 10 minutes/level.

name: Mark of the Outcast
description: Places a permanent, indelible skull-shaped mark on the target's face (or other upper body part) visible to normal vision, low-light vision, and darkvision. The marked creature takes a −5 circumstance penalty on Bluff and Diplomacy checks and a −2 penalty to AC. Will negates. The mark cannot be dispelled but can be removed by break enchantment, limited wish, miracle, remove curse, or wish.

name: Master Air
description: You sprout insubstantial feathery or batlike wings (your choice) and gain a fly speed of 90 feet with good maneuverability (60 feet if wearing medium or heavy armor). Flying requires no more concentration than walking, so you can attack or cast spells normally; you can charge but not run, and cannot carry more than your maximum load plus worn armor. If the duration expires while you're still aloft, you fall 60 feet per round for 1d6 rounds, landing safely if you reach the ground within that time, otherwise falling the rest of the distance and taking normal falling damage (dispelling the spell has the same effect). Duration 1 round/level. Requires a focus: a bird's wing feather or a bat's wing bone.

name: Mountain Stance
description: Touch a creature to let it root itself to the ground as a free action for the duration. While rooted, the subject gains a bonus equal to your caster level against attempts to grapple, lift, push, bull rush, overrun, throw, trip, or otherwise forcibly move it. If such an attempt succeeds anyway and the subject is moved, the spell ends immediately. Voluntary movement doesn't end the spell (though the subject isn't rooted while moving), and it can re-root itself elsewhere afterward. Will negates (harmless); duration 1 minute/level.

name: Nature’s Favor
description: A swift-action touch spell that grants the target animal a +1 luck bonus on attack and damage rolls per three caster levels (maximum +5). Will negates (harmless); duration 1 minute.

name: One With the Land
description: You gain a +2 competence bonus on Handle Animal, Hide, Move Silently, Search, Survival, and wild empathy checks for the duration.

name: Saltray
description: You fire a ray of whirling salt crystals, requiring a ranged touch attack to hit. On a hit, the target takes 1d6 points of damage per two caster levels (maximum 5d6) and must succeed on a Fortitude save or be stunned for 1 round.

name: Scent
description: The creature you touch gains the scent ability (MM 314) for the duration. Material component: a sprinkle of mustard and pepper.

name: Share Husk
description: You perceive through a touched animal's senses (sight and hearing), using either your own or the animal's Listen/Spot modifier, whichever is better, though you gain no special understanding of what you sense. You can switch your perception between your own senses and the animal's as a free action on your turn. You and the animal must remain on the same plane for the spell to function. Material component: an edible treat appealing to the animal.

name: Snake’s Swiftness, Mass

targetAreaEffect.value: Allied creatures in a 20-ft.- radius burst

description: Functions like snake's swiftness, except it affects multiple allied creatures in a 20-ft.-radius burst out to medium range instead of a single subject.

name: Splinterbolt

targetAreaEffect.value: One or more streams of splinters

description: You fire a splinter of wood, requiring a ranged attack to hit; on a hit it deals 4d6 points of piercing damage and threatens a critical hit on 18-20. You can fire one additional splinterbolt for every four caster levels beyond 3rd (maximum three at 11th level), aimed at the same or different targets, provided all targets are within 30 feet of each other and all are fired simultaneously. Damage reduction applies normally, but the damage counts as magic and piercing for overcoming it. Material component: a splinter of wood.

name: Swim
description: The touched creature gains a swim speed of 30 feet (but not water breathing or extended breath-holding). While carrying no more than a light load, it can swim without Swim checks, gains a +8 bonus on Swim checks for special actions or hazards (weight-carried penalty still applies), can take 10 on Swim checks even when rushed or threatened, and can use the run action while swimming in a straight line. If carrying more than a light load, it must make Swim checks to move (with the normal weight penalty), though the other benefits still apply. Material component: a goldfish scale.

name: Tiger’s Tooth
description: Functions like magic fang (PH 250), except it is cast as a swift action, targets a living creature (typically an animal companion), and lasts only 1 round.

name: Train Animal
description: The affected animal gains a number of additional tricks equal to half your caster level (maximum five) for the duration. This does not change the animal's attitude toward you or guarantee it will cooperate when instructed to perform the newly learned tricks.

name: Wings of Air
description: A winged creature you touch has its flight maneuverability improve by one grade (clumsy to poor, poor to average, average to good, or good to perfect) for the duration. The subject must be capable of flight using wings, and multiple castings on the same creature don't stack.

name: Winter’s Embrace
description: A target that fails its initial Fortitude save takes 1d8 points of cold damage each round at the start of your turn; each round it may attempt a new Fortitude save to avoid that round's damage. The second time the subject takes damage from a single casting, it becomes fatigued; the fourth time, it becomes exhausted.

name: Wracking Touch
description: A melee touch deals 1d6 points of damage +1 per caster level (maximum +10), Fortitude save for half. If you have the sneak attack ability, you also deal sneak attack damage (unless the target is immune to extra damage from critical hits), without needing the target to be flanked or denied its Dexterity bonus; the base spell damage applies even if sneak attack damage doesn't.

name: Nature’s Balance
description: You take a -4 penalty to your choice of Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution (no save allowed), and the touched subject gains an equivalent bonus to that same ability score for the duration; the subject may attempt a Fortitude save to decline the bonus if desired.

name: Air Breathing
description: Touched living creatures can breathe air freely for the duration (2 hours/level, divided evenly among all creatures touched); it does not prevent them from also breathing water. Arcane material component: a short reed or piece of straw.

name: Align Fang, Mass

targetAreaEffect.value: One creature/level, no two of which are more than 30 ft. apart

description: Functions like align fang, except it affects one creature per level, no two of which may be more than 30 feet apart, at a distance (close range) rather than a single touched ally.

name: Attune Form
description: You attune the affected creatures (one per 3 caster levels) to the plane you are currently on, negating that plane's harmful effects; affected creatures gain the protections described in the avoid planar effects spell. Duration 24 hours. Arcane material component: a bit of stone or earth from your home plane.

otherPrintings.note: Planar Handbook's version differs mechanically: target "one or more creatures touched" and duration "2 hours/level," vs. this entry's "one creature/3 levels" and flat 24-hour duration.

name: Bite of the Werewolf
description: You gain a +2 enhancement bonus to Strength, +4 enhancement bonus to Dexterity, +4 enhancement bonus to Constitution, and +4 enhancement bonus to natural armor. You gain a bite attack dealing 1d6 points of damage (1d4 if you are Small) plus 1-1/2 times your Strength modifier, and you gain the benefit of the Blind-Fight feat. If your base attack bonus is +6 or higher, you gain no additional attacks from this bonus. Material component: a wolf's tooth.

name: Blindsight
description: The touched creature gains the blindsight ability (MM 306) out to 30 feet for the duration.

name: Bottle of Smoke
description: You create a plume of smoke captured in a special corked bottle (focus, worth at least 50 gp). Opening the bottle before the duration expires releases the smoke as a silent, intangible, horse-like creature that anyone can pass through. Mounting it requires a DC 10 Ride check while holding the bottle in one hand; mounting without the bottle just passes through it, and letting go of the bottle after mounting causes the rider to fall through, unable to remount without the bottle. Breaking the bottle ends the spell immediately (dropping any rider). The smoke horse has a speed of 20 feet per caster level (max 240 feet) and can lay a trail of smoke 5 feet wide and 20 feet high behind it as it moves (free action to start/stop), lasting 10 minutes once laid; a severe or magical wind instantly disperses the horse and its smoke. The horse and its trail grant concealment to anyone behind them. The horse is immune to all damage and attacks (things pass through it) and cannot attack. The rider can return the horse to the bottle to pause the spell by corking it (move action) then re-stoppering it the following round; reopening the bottle later resumes the spell with remaining duration intact. Regardless of remaining duration, the spell ends 24 hours after casting, and dispelling it while corked ends it.

name: Capricious Zephyr
savingThrow: None or Reﬂex partial; see text
description: You create a 5-ft.-diameter sphere of swirling wind and dust that moves 30 feet per round in a direction you point, ignoring terrain. If it enters a creature's space, it stops for that round and attempts a bull rush against the creature (the sphere gets a +6 bonus on the check); if it wins, the creature is pushed as far as possible in a random direction (roll 1d8: 1 = toward you, 2-8 = clockwise around the creature), and a pushed creature must succeed on a Reflex save or fall prone. The sphere only moves when you actively direct it (a move action for you); otherwise it stays in place and tries to bowl over anyone in its square. The spell ends if the sphere ever moves beyond the spell's range from you.

name: Charge of the Triceratops
description: You touch a creature, granting it large horns, a bony skull plate, and thickened hide. The horns grant a gore attack dealing 1d8 damage (1d6 if the subject is Small, 2d6 if Large), doubled if used as part of a charge. As a primary weapon it adds 1.5x Str bonus to damage; as a secondary weapon it adds only 0.5x Str bonus and takes a -5 attack penalty. The recipient also gains a +4 enhancement bonus to natural armor. Lasts 1 round/level.

name: Circle Dance
description: After a 1-minute dance, you divine the relative direction and physical/emotional condition (unharmed, wounded, unconscious, dying, etc.) of a creature you have firsthand knowledge of, provided it is alive and on the same plane as you. If the creature is on a different plane or is dead, you sense nothing.

name: Corona of Cold
description: You surround yourself with a protective aura of cold in a 10-ft-radius emanation, gaining resistance to fire 10. Starting the round you cast it, all other creatures in the area take 1d12 cold damage each round at the start of your turn; a successful Fortitude save negates that round's damage only. Creatures damaged shiver uncontrollably, taking a -2 penalty to Strength and Dexterity and moving at half speed while in the area; these penalties don't stack with repeated damage or additional castings. Lasts 1 round/level.

name: Creaking Cacophony
description: Creates an overwhelming cacophony of groaning, creaking noise in a 40-ft-radius spread, audible (though merely loud) well beyond the area. Creatures within the area take a -4 penalty on Listen checks, and spellcasters must make a Concentration check (DC = this spell's DC + the level of the spell being cast) to cast any spell. Creatures in the area without sonic immunity gain vulnerability to sonic damage. Lasts 1 round/level.

name: Crumble
description: Ages a fabricated structure or construct (not natural objects) rapidly, dealing 1d8 damage per caster level (max 10d8), ignoring hardness. Fortitude save for half damage; spell resistance applies. Maximum affectable object size scales with caster level: Large up to 9th, Huge 10th-15th, Gargantuan 16th-18th, Colossal 19th-20th; targeting an object larger than your level allows causes the spell to fail.

name: Dehydrate
description: Curses a target creature with desiccation, dealing 1d6 Constitution damage plus 1 additional point per three caster levels (max 1d6+5 at 15th level). Oozes, plants, and creatures with the aquatic subtype are more susceptible, taking 1d8 Constitution damage plus 1 additional point per three caster levels (max 1d8+5) instead. Fortitude negates.

name: Downdraft
description: Sends a column of turbulent air down a 20-ft-radius, 100-ft-high cylinder. Airborne creatures in the area must succeed on a Reflex save or plummet up to 100 feet straight down, taking falling damage (1d6 per 10 feet) if they hit the ground or an object; those who save still plummet 50 feet. Creatures already on the ground must save or be knocked prone. Requires a balsa-wood bird carving as a material component, crushed underfoot.

name: Energy Vortex

targetAreaEffect.value: All creatures within a 20-ft.- radius burst centered on you

description: You choose acid, cold, electricity, or fire; that energy bursts outward from you in a 20-ft-radius burst, dealing 1d8 damage +1/caster level (max +20) to nearby creatures other than you. No Reflex save is allowed, but spell resistance and any resistances/immunities to that energy type apply. If you're willing to take the damage yourself, you deal twice as much damage instead. The spell's descriptor matches the chosen energy type.

name: Entangling Staff
description: As a swift action, causes your quarterstaff to sprout vines. When you strike a foe with the staff in melee, you deal normal damage and may attempt a grapple as a free action (no attacks of opportunity, no separate touch attack needed), with a +8 bonus on the grapple check; you can grapple creatures up to one size category larger than yourself. On a successful grapple check, the vines constrict for 2d6 damage (lethal or nonlethal, your choice). You may then release (leaving the foe entangled for the spell's duration while you're free to attack others) or maintain the hold (dealing constriction damage again on future successful grapple checks). Requires a quarterstaff focus. Lasts 1 round/level.

name: Fire Wings
description: Transforms your arms into wings of flame that don't harm you or your gear. You can't hold items or cast spells with somatic components while transformed, though worn items like rings and bracers still function. You gain a fly speed of 60 ft (40 ft in medium/heavy armor) with good maneuverability; you can charge but not run while flying, and can carry no more than a light load aloft. Casting requires no more concentration than walking. If the duration ends while aloft, you descend 60 ft/round for 1d6 rounds before falling the rest of the way (same if dispelled, but not if negated by antimagic field). While not flying, you can make up to two natural-weapon attacks per round with the wings, each dealing 2d6 fire damage. The wings can be extinguished (ending the spell) by quench, immersion in water, or hurricane-force wind. Requires burning a feather as a material component and a golden phoenix amulet (150 gp) as a focus. Lasts 1 minute/level.

name: Forestfold
description: Changes your coloring and attunes your footfalls to one chosen terrain type (aquatic, desert, plains, forest, hills, mountains, marsh, or underground). While in terrain of that type you gain a +10 competence bonus on Hide and Move Silently checks; the bonus persists even if you leave and return to that terrain within the duration. Lasts 1 hour/level.

name: Giant’s Wrath
description: Infuses one pebble per 3 caster levels with transmutation magic. For the duration, you may hurl a pebble as an attack action (provokes attacks of opportunity); upon leaving your hand it becomes a boulder with a 120-ft range increment, requiring a ranged attack roll. A hit deals 2d6 bludgeoning damage + Str modifier, and you gain an insight bonus equal to your caster level (max +10) on both attack and damage rolls with these boulders. If a pebble is dropped or given away, its magic dissipates harmlessly. Requires the pebbles as a material component. Lasts 1 round/level.

name: Girallon’s Blessing
description: Grants the touched creature an additional pair of arms ending in clawed hands; original arms (if any) are primary, new ones secondary (or primary if it had none). The creature gains four claw attacks using its base attack bonus + Str modifier, each dealing 1d4 + Str modifier damage; if two or more claws hit the same opponent in one round, it can rend for an extra 2d4 + 1.5x Str modifier damage. The creature cannot use normal weapons and claws in the same round, and gains no extra claw attacks from a high base attack bonus. Requires girallon hair as a material component. Fortitude negates (harmless). Lasts 10 minutes/level.

name: Heatstroke
description: Afflicts a target as if it had suffered hours under a desert sun. On a failed Fortitude save, the target becomes fatigued (or exhausted if already fatigued); it also takes 2d6 nonlethal damage regardless of whether the save succeeds. Creatures wearing heavy armor take a -4 penalty on the save. Creatures with fire immunity or resistance are unaffected.

name: Hypothermia
description: The subject takes 1d6 cold damage per caster level (max 10d6) and becomes fatigued; a successful Fortitude save halves the damage and negates the fatigue.

name: Infestation of Maggots
description: A successful melee touch attack infests the target with magical maggots. On a failed Fortitude save, the maggots deal 1d4 Constitution damage each round at the start of your turn; the subject may attempt a new Fortitude save each round to negate that round's damage and end the effect. The infestation can be removed by remove disease or heal. Requires a handful of dead, dried flies as a material component. Lasts 1 round/2 levels.

name: Jagged Tooth

targetAreaEffect.value: One natural slashing or piercing weapon of target creature

description: Doubles the critical threat range of one natural weapon (dealing slashing or piercing damage) belonging to the target creature. Multiple effects that increase threat range don't stack. Will negates (harmless). Lasts 10 minutes/level.

name: Junglerazer
description: Unleashes destructive energy in a 120-ft line, instantly killing natural plant life and leaving ash in its wake. Fey, vermin, plants and plant creatures, and animals in the area take 1d10 negative energy damage per caster level (max 10d10); Reflex halves. Requires a pinch of ash from a burnt plant as a material component.

name: Lion’s Charge
description: Surrounds you with a nimbus of yellow energy shaped like a lion, granting you the pounce special ability, allowing you to make a full attack at the end of a charge. Lasts 1 round.

name: Nature’s Rampart
description: After 10 minutes of casting, reshapes a natural setting (open outdoor site, rough outdoor site/cavern, or marshy/low-lying site) up to 40 ft square into a defensive position; artificial structures are unaffected, though the effect can be placed to fill gaps between buildings or block a road. On an open outdoor site, it raises a 5-ft-high, 5-ft-thick (at base) earthen dike behind a 5-ft-wide, 5-ft-deep ditch around the perimeter, giving cover to defenders behind it and requiring attackers to cross the ditch and climb (Climb DC 10). On a rough outdoor site or cavern, it arranges stones, dead wood, and briars into a defensible 5-ft-high, 2-ft-thick wall giving cover. On marshy/low-lying terrain, it instead creates a 10-ft-wide, 5-ft-deep water-filled ditch that reduces wading creatures to 1/4 speed (minimum 5 ft) and prevents charging or running. Requires a quartz gem focus carved with a tiny castle, worth at least 100 gp.

name: Primal Form
description: You choose an element (air, earth, fire, or water) and take on the appearance and many qualities of a Medium elemental of that type (MM 96–100), gaining the elemental subtype. You get a +4 bonus on saves against mind-affecting effects and a 25% chance to negate critical hits and sneak attacks (as light fortification). You cannot cast spells and lose your own form's spell-like, supernatural, and extraordinary abilities. You gain an element-specific benefit: air grants a 20-ft. perfect fly speed; earth grants DR 5/—; fire grants 1d4 fire damage, fire resistance 10, and the burn quality; water grants a 90-ft. swim speed and the drench quality. Your equipment melds into your new form and stops functioning. Lasts 1 minute/level (D).

name: Quillfire
description: Your hand sprouts poisonous quills usable in melee or thrown (10-ft. range increment). They deal 1d8 damage and carry an injury poison (DC equal to quillfire's save DC, 1d6 Str initial and secondary damage). Lasts 1 round/level.

name: Resist Energy, Mass

targetAreaEffect.value: One creature/level, no two of which are more than 30 ft. apart

description: Functions as resist energy (PH 272), granting resistance to a chosen energy type, except it affects one creature per level, no two of which are more than 30 ft. apart. Lasts 10 min./level; Fortitude negates (harmless).

name: Sink

targetAreaEffect.value: One creature/3 levels, no two of which are more than 30 ft. apart

description: Targets currently in water or another liquid (one creature per 3 levels, no two more than 30 ft. apart) sink 100 feet down, or to the bottom if the liquid is shallower, unless they succeed on a Will save. Affected creatures can swim back up normally afterward; once on the bottom, a creature needs a Swim check to move or can move at one-quarter its land speed.

name: Snakebite
description: One of your arms becomes a venomous serpent for 1 round/level (D). As an attack action you can bite an opponent in melee, dealing 1d3 + Str modifier damage plus 2 points of Constitution damage as both initial and secondary poison damage (each instance negated by a separate Fortitude save vs. the spell's DC). You can't hold a weapon with the transformed hand, but your other hand still works normally for weapons or somatic spell components; fighting with the snake arm and a weapon uses standard two-weapon fighting penalties. Only one snakebite can affect you at a time.

name: Snowshoes, Mass

targetAreaEffect.value: One creature/level, no two of which are more than 30 ft. apart

description: Functions as snowshoes (letting subjects walk atop snow without sinking), except it affects one creature per level, no two of which are more than 30 ft. apart. Lasts 1 hour/level (D); Will negates (harmless).

name: Spiderskin
description: The touched creature gains a +1 enhancement bonus to its existing natural armor, a +1 racial bonus on saves vs. poison, and a +1 racial bonus on Hide checks, each improving by +1 per 3 caster levels (+2 at CL 6, +3 at CL 9, +4 at CL 12, +5 at CL 15). The natural armor bonus stacks with the creature's own natural armor but not with other enhancement bonuses to natural armor; a creature without natural armor is treated as having +0. Lasts 10 minutes/level; Will negates (harmless). Arcane casters need a spider's leg as a material component.

name: Spikes
description: Functions like brambles (p. 38), except the touched wooden weapon instead gains a +2 enhancement bonus on attack rolls and has its threat range doubled; this doesn't stack with other threat-range increases such as Improved Critical. Lasts 1 round/level.

name: Spiritjaws
description: Creates spectral jaws of force that attack a designated creature at medium range starting the round of casting and each round after, using your base attack bonus (possibly multiple attacks/round) + Wis modifier to hit. A hit deals 2d6 damage and attempts a free grapple check (attack bonus + 4); once the target is grappled, each subsequent successful grapple check deals another 2d6 damage instead of a normal attack. The grappled target can't move, loses Dex bonus to AC against non-grappling foes, and threatens no squares. The jaws get no flanking bonus and don't help others flank, aren't affected by your feats, and vanish if they leave spell range; they can't be harmed except by disintegrate or a sphere of annihilation. A grappled creature can cast only spells with no somatic component and material components already in hand, after succeeding on a DC 20 + spell level Concentration check; it can escape via a grapple check or an Escape Artist check (standard action) opposed by the jaws. As a free action you can direct the jaws to pin instead of damage; a pinned target is immobile until it breaks the pin, and other creatures get +4 on attacks against it. Multiple attacks from high BAB can be split between damaging/grappling and pinning attempts. If you lose the ability to command the jaws, they vanish. Lasts 1 round/level (D); requires a piece of dinosaur jawbone as a material component.

name: Standing Wave

targetAreaEffect.value: Waves under a creature or object within range

description: You cause water to lift and propel a creature or object (which may itself hold creatures or objects) forward in a straight line at 60 ft./round over water. Maximum size that can be lifted scales with caster level: Medium at CL 5, Large at 7, Huge at 9, Gargantuan at 11, Colossal at 13. The wave dissipates and lowers its burden harmlessly when it reaches land. If you're riding or standing on the lifted object, it keeps moving as long as you remain on it or until you dismiss the spell; otherwise it moves only as far as the spell's range allows from where you cast it. Reflex negates; lasts up to 10 minutes/level (D).

name: Thornskin
description: Your skin sprouts thorns for 1 round/level (D). Your unarmed strikes deal lethal damage (if they didn't already) plus an extra 1d6 piercing damage — e.g., a human's unarmed strike becomes 1d3 bludgeoning + 1d6 piercing. Any creature that hits you with a natural weapon, unarmed strike, or successful grapple check takes 5 points of piercing damage. Damage reduction applies against this damage, which counts as piercing for overcoming DR. Requires a thorn as a material component.

name: Thunderous Roar
description: A blast of thunderous sound fills a 20-ft.-radius burst at long range, dealing 1d6 sonic damage per two caster levels (maximum 5d6) to everyone in the area, halved on a successful Fortitude save. Any creature that takes damage must also succeed on a Reflex save or be knocked prone. Crystalline creatures instead take 1d6 sonic damage per caster level (maximum 10d6). Instantaneous.

name: Treasure Scent
description: For 1 hour/level you can detect copper, silver, gold, platinum, and gems within 30 feet, distinguishing between the five types. Detection reveals only presence and direction, not exact location, until you come within 5 feet of the treasure, at which point you can pinpoint it exactly. The effect penetrates barriers except 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

name: Tremor
description: Creates a minor localized earthquake in a 40-ft.-radius spread, too weak to damage structures, lasting 1 round per 3 caster levels. Each round, any spellcaster on the ground in the area must succeed on a Concentration check (DC 15 + spell level) or lose the spell they're casting; a creature attempting a skill that provokes attacks of opportunity (Disable Device, Heal, Open Lock, Use Rope, etc.) must succeed on a DC 15 Concentration check or the action automatically fails and is wasted. Each round, every creature in the area must also make a Reflex save or be knocked prone.

name: Vigor
description: Functions like lesser vigor, except it grants the touched living creature fast healing 2. Lasts 10 rounds + 1 round/level (maximum 25 rounds); Will negates (harmless).

name: Vigor, Mass Lesser

targetAreaEffect.value: One creature/2 levels, no two of which are more than 30 ft. apart

description: Functions like lesser vigor, except it affects one creature per 2 levels within 20 feet, no two of which are more than 30 ft. apart, each gaining lesser vigor's fast-healing effect for 10 rounds + 1 round/level (maximum 25 rounds). Will negates (harmless).

name: Vine Mine
description: You create a burst of rapidly growing vines in a 10-ft.-radius/level spread at medium range, choosing one effect when cast: act as a climbing aid (as knotted rope), bind helpless targets (Escape Artist DC 25 to escape), hamper movement (as heavy undergrowth), or provide camouflage (+4 competence bonus on Hide checks). As a standard action you can redirect the vines to switch to a different effect. Lasts 10 minutes/level; requires a crown of ivy leaves as a material component.

name: Weather Eye
description: After an hour of scrying, you accurately predict natural weather up to one week ahead within a radius of 1 mile + 1 mile/level centered on you. If unnatural forces are currently affecting the weather, the spell reveals which spells or abilities are responsible, though not their source. Requires incense as a material component and a scrying focus (bowl, mirror, crystal ball, etc.). Instantaneous.

name: Arc of Lightning
description: A bolt of electricity arcs along a line between two creatures you designate (both must be in range and valid targets), dealing 1d6 points of electricity damage per caster level (maximum 15d6) to both creatures and anything else in the line between them. Reflex half. Arcane casters need two small iron rods as a material component.

name: Bite of the Wereboar
description: For 1 round/level you gain a +4 enhancement bonus to Strength, +6 to Constitution, and +8 to natural armor. Your face becomes boar-like, granting a bite attack dealing 1d8 damage (1d6 if you are Small) + 1-1/2 times your Str modifier, plus the benefit of the Blind-Fight feat. If your base attack bonus is +6 or higher, you gain no additional attacks from this spell. Requires four boar bristles as a material component.

name: Blindsight, Greater
description: Functions like the blindsight spell, except that the blindsight granted extends out to 60 feet. Touch range, 1 minute/level duration, Will negates (harmless), SR yes (harmless).

name: Burrow, Mass

targetAreaEffect.value: One creature/level, no two of which are more than 30 ft. apart

description: Functions like burrow, except it affects one creature per level (no two more than 30 ft. apart) instead of a single target. Each affected ally's hands take on a yellow nimbus and become large digging mole-hands. Duration 1 minute/level (D); Will negates (harmless), SR yes (harmless).

name: Chain of Eyes
description: Touch a living creature to see through its eyes instead of your own, though you gain no control over it. Whenever the subject makes physical contact with another living creature, you may transfer your viewpoint to that new creature; each transfer allows the new target a Will save and SR, and a successful resist ends the spell. On your turn you may use a free action to switch between the linked creature's sight and your own normal vision. Duration 1 hour/level.

name: Contagious Touch
description: On casting, choose one disease: blinding sickness, cackle fever, filth fever, mindfire, red ache, the shakes, or slimy doom. Any living creature you hit with a melee touch attack during the spell's duration (1 round/level) contracts that disease as though affected by contagion, unless it succeeds on a Fortitude save. You can infect no more than one creature per round.

name: Contingent Energy Resistance
description: Similar to contingency but narrower in scope: while active (1 hour/level (D)), the first time you take damage from acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic energy, the spell automatically grants you resistance 10 against that energy type for up to 10 minutes per caster level or the remainder of the duration, whichever is shorter, as if under resist energy. Once the triggering energy type is set it cannot change. Only one casting can be active on you at a time — casting it again ends the earlier one. Its resistance does not stack with resist energy or similar effects against the same energy type, but you can have this active against one energy type while under resist energy for a different type simultaneously. Material component: an oyster shell.

name: Creeping Cold, Greater
description: Functions like creeping cold, but the duration is extended by 1 round, dealing 4d6 points of cold damage (Fortitude half) during that time. At caster level 15+, the spell lasts 5 rounds dealing 5d6 cold damage; at caster level 20+, it lasts 6 rounds dealing 6d6 cold damage.

name: Enhance Wild Shape
description: Infuses your wild shape ability with magical energy. At casting, choose one enhancement that cannot later be changed: your next wild shape form is a plant, gains the extraordinary abilities of that form, or gains a +2 bonus to Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution (pick one). The chosen benefit applies the next time you use wild shape during the spell's 1 hour/level duration, lasts only as long as you remain in that form (or until the spell expires), and does not carry over to subsequent wild shape uses. If you never wild shape during the duration, the spell has no effect. Multiple castings can be active at once, but each must select a different enhancement.

name: Essence of the Raptor
description: Personal transmutation, duration 10 minutes/level (D). Your appearance is unchanged, but your speed increases to 60 feet (no effect if already 60 feet or faster), you gain a +8 bonus on Hide, Jump, Listen, Spot, and Survival checks, and you gain the scent ability.

name: Eye of the Hurricane

targetAreaEffect.value: 40-ft.-radius emanation centered on you, with 10-ft.-radius quiet area centered on you

description: Creates a 40-ft.-radius emanation of hurricane-force winds centered on you, with a 10-ft.-radius calm eye at the center where you and anyone there are unaffected; the area moves to stay centered on you as you move. Normal ranged attacks through the wind are impossible, and siege weapons/heavy projectiles take a -8 attack penalty. Creatures entering or starting their turn in the windy area must save (re-saving each time they re-enter or start a turn there): Medium or smaller creatures need a Fortitude save or are knocked prone and blown 1d4x10 ft. away, taking 1d4 nonlethal damage per 10 ft. traveled (flying creatures instead blown back 2d6x10 ft. for 2d6 nonlethal damage); Large creatures need a Fortitude save or are knocked prone (flying creatures blown back 1d6x10 ft.); Huge creatures need a Fortitude save or are checked (flying creatures blown back 1d6x5 ft.); Gargantuan and Colossal creatures are unaffected. Duration 1 round/level.

name: Jaws of the Wolf
description: Turns small wooden carvings into a number of worgs equal to one per two caster levels, appearing between you and your foes. They act independently but obey your mental commands. If a worg moves beyond the spell's range or the spell ends (1 round/level (D)), it reverts to a carving; killing a worg destroys its carving. Focus: one worg carving per creature created, 25 gp each.

name: Land Womb
description: Touching the ground opens a secure underground refuge 10 ft. below the surface, reachable only through tillable soil (not stone or rock). You may bring one additional creature per caster level, provided all creatures are touching each other when the spell is cast. Those inside cannot be detected by divination spells of 4th level or lower, cannot perceive the surface by nonmagical means, and can still cast spells despite the tight space. You can end the spell early, but companions cannot. When the duration (10 minutes/level (D)) ends, everyone returns to the spot they occupied when the spell was cast.

name: Languor
description: Requires a successful ranged touch attack with a ray. The struck creature takes a Strength penalty of 1d6+1 per two caster levels (maximum 1d6+10), and if it also fails a Will save, it becomes slowed for the spell's duration (1 round/level). This slow effect counters and is countered by haste.

name: Last Breath
description: Must be cast by touching a creature within 1 round of its death. Functions like reincarnate, restoring it to life in a new body, except the creature suffers no level loss, no Constitution loss, and no loss of spells; it returns at -1 hit points but stable. Material component: rare oils and unguents worth at least 500 gp, spread over the remains.

name: Lay of the Land
description: After a 3-round casting time, you gain an instant mental overview of the region within 50 miles, showing major landmarks such as rivers, lakes, and settlements of at least hamlet size, along with their direction and distance from you. Unlike find the path, it reveals nothing about traps, passwords, or other impediments to travel. Arcane focus: a small piece of lodestone.

otherPrintings.note: Planar Handbook's focus component is F only (no DF alternative).

name: Magic Fang, Superior
description: Grants every natural weapon you possess an enhancement bonus on attack and damage rolls equal to +1 per four caster levels (maximum +5 at 20th level). Personal range, duration 1 round/level.

name: Miasma of Entropy

targetAreaEffect.value: Cone-shaped burst or one solid object; see text

savingThrow: Fortitude half or Will negates (object); see text
description: Causes accelerated decay in nonmagical wood, leather, paper, and other formerly living organic material within a cone-shaped burst from you (30 ft. range), turning affected objects into slimy pulp. Objects weighing more than 1 lb. per caster level are unaffected; all other qualifying objects in the area are ruined. Alternatively, you can target a single solid, nonliving, nonmagical organic object weighing up to 10 lb. per caster level instead of using the cone. Fortitude half or Will negates (object), SR yes (object).

name: Moon Bolt

targetAreaEffect.value: One living or undead creature, or two living or undead creatures that are no more than 15 ft. apart; see text

savingThrow: Fortitude half (living target) or Will negates (undead target)
description: Fires a bolt of moonlight that strikes unerringly (no attack roll needed) against one living or undead creature at long range, or two such creatures within 15 ft. of each other. A living target takes 1d4 points of Strength damage per three caster levels (maximum 5d4), halved on a successful Fortitude save. An undead target must succeed on a Will save or fall helpless for 1d4 rounds; afterward it can stand but takes a -2 penalty on attack rolls and Will saves for the next minute.

name: Murderous Mist

targetAreaEffect.value: Cloud spreads in a 30-ft. radius, 20 ft. high

description: Creates a 30-ft.-radius, 20-ft.-tall cloud of scalding steam that moves away from you in a straight line at 10 ft./round for the spell's duration (1 round/level). Anyone inside takes 2d6 points of damage and is permanently blinded, or takes half damage and avoids blinding with a successful Reflex save. Creatures in the cloud have concealment. Wind doesn't redirect the cloud, but a moderate wind (11+ mph) disperses it in 4 rounds and a strong wind (21+ mph) disperses it in 1 round.

name: Perinarch

targetAreaEffect.value: A radius of raw Limbo within close range

savingThrow: None (object) and Reflex negates; see text
description: Grants automatic control over a radius of raw, uncontrolled Limbo within close range, bypassing the normal DC 16 Wisdom check natives use to control the plane's chaos. As a standard action once per round, you can add or remove one of the four basic elements to reshape the area. Allies can voluntarily transfer their own control to you while the spell is active, and no one can wrest control from you during its duration; control fades if you move more than 100 ft. from the area. You can only produce crude effects mixing two or three elements, not complex constructions, and can attempt to seize an area already occupied by foes (who get a Reflex save to escape). Example effects: a Thick Barrier that slows outside creatures to a 5-ft. (10-ft. for Large or larger) speed to push through; a Fiery Barrier dealing 3d10 fire damage to cross and 3d10 per round to creatures lingering in it; and a Complete Barrier of solid stone up to 1 ft. thick encircling you and allies (or trapping foes inside a stone bubble). Duration 1 round/level.

otherPrintings.note: Planar Handbook itself does not print a target/area line; this entry's "A radius of raw Limbo within close range" is Spell Compendium's addition.

name: Planar Tolerance

targetAreaEffect.value: One creature/level in a 20-ft.-radius burst centered on you

description: Functions like avoid planar effects, except as noted for this version: cast as an immediate action, affecting one creature per level in a 20-ft.-radius burst centered on you, lasting 1 hour/level.

name: Poison Vines
description: Functions like vine mine, except the vines are poisonous (contact poison, 1d6 Dex initial/2d6 Dex secondary). A Fortitude save is required only on first entering the area and again 1 minute later, not every round or every entry. You are immune to the poison, and you may designate a number of other creatures equal to your caster level to share that immunity.

name: Resistance, Greater
description: Functions like resistance, except it grants a +3 resistance bonus on saving throws. Touch range, lasts 24 hours.

name: Rushing Waters
description: A wave of cold water erupts outward from a chosen point, making a bull rush attempt against every creature in the 15-ft-radius area without provoking attacks of opportunity, using a +15 bonus on the opposed Strength check. If the wave wins, the defender is pushed 5 feet directly away from the origin point, plus 5 more feet for every 5 points by which the check result is exceeded. Any creature moved 5 feet or more must succeed on a Reflex save or fall prone. The wave also drenches the area and extinguishes any normal fire up to the size of a bonfire.

name: Shadowblast
description: A flash of light disperses portals to the Plane of Shadow and harms creatures native to it. Shadow Plane natives in the 20-ft-radius area are stunned for 1d6 rounds unless they succeed on a Fortitude save. Those that are also undead or vulnerable to light take an additional 2d10 damage unless they succeed on a second Fortitude save. Any creature that fails either save cannot use spell-like or supernatural abilities to open a portal to the Plane of Shadow for 3d6 minutes. The spell also closes all portals and gates to the Plane of Shadow within its area (creatures already on the far side are unaffected). Requires a pinch of grave dirt as a material component.

name: Sheltered Vitality
description: Touch spell that grants the subject immunity to fatigue, exhaustion, and any ability damage or ability drain (regardless of source) for 1 minute per caster level.

name: Spark of Life
description: Touching an undead creature makes it vulnerable to effects that normally only harm the living for the spell's duration (1 round/level): extra damage from critical hits and sneak attacks, nonlethal damage, ability drain, energy drain, fatigue, exhaustion, and damage to physical ability scores (it still has no Constitution score and can't take Con damage). It loses immunity to Fortitude-save effects and its normal immunities to poison, sleep, paralysis, stunning, disease, and death effects, but gains a bonus on Fortitude saves equal to its Charisma bonus (not applicable to saves against effects that also affect objects). It must breathe, eat, and sleep like a living creature. While affected, both negative energy (e.g. inflict spells) and positive energy (e.g. cure spells) heal it rather than damaging it. It keeps all its other traits. Will negates; SR applies.

name: Starvation
