description: Target must succeed on a Fortitude save or take 1d6 nonlethal damage per caster level (maximum 10d6) and become fatigued; a successful save halves the damage and prevents fatigue. If the target fails the save it takes the nonlethal damage and becomes exhausted (rather than merely fatigued) — normally a fatigued creature only becomes exhausted if it does something else that would cause fatigue, but a failed save here directly triggers that outcome. Requires a piece of spoiled food as a material component.

name: Sudden Stalagmite
description: A stalagmite up to 1 foot wide and 10 feet tall (stops growing early if it hits a ceiling) erupts from the ground beneath the target. Airborne creatures within 10 feet of the ground get a +4 bonus on their save; airborne creatures more than 10 feet up are unaffected. It deals 1d6 piercing damage per caster level (max 10d6) on a failed Reflex save (half on success); a target that fails and takes damage is impaled and cannot move until it succeeds on a DC 15 Escape Artist check, breaks free with a DC 25 Strength check (taking 3d6 slashing damage), or the stalagmite is removed by other means (e.g. stone shape). Damage reduction applies normally; the damage counts as piercing for overcoming DR.

name: Summon Elementite Swarm
description: Summons one elementite swarm (air, earth, fire, or water, caster's choice) from the corresponding Elemental Plane. It appears where designated, acts immediately on your turn, understands your speech, and obeys your commands (commanding it is a free action). You must concentrate to maintain the spell, which lasts up to 1 round per level plus 1 round. As with any summoning of an elemental creature, the spell takes on that element's descriptor.

name: Surefooted Stride, Mass

targetAreaEffect.value: One creature/level, no two of which are more than 30 ft. apart

description: Functions like surefooted stride, except it affects one creature per caster level, no two of which can be more than 30 feet apart, at close range.

name: Swim, Mass

targetAreaEffect.value: One creature/level, no two of which are more than 30 ft. apart

description: Functions like swim, except it affects one creature per caster level (no two more than 30 feet apart) instead of a single target. Duration 10 minutes/level (dismissible).

name: Vortex of Teeth

targetAreaEffect.value: Hollow cylinder (40-ft. radius, 20 ft. high, with a 5-ft.-radius safe zone at the center)

description: Conjures a swarm of transparent force-piranhas that swim through a hollow cylindrical area (40-ft radius, 20 ft tall, with a 5-ft-radius safe zone at the center that some larger creatures may not be able to use). Creatures in the area take 3d8 damage each round at the start of the caster's turn; being a force effect, it also harms incorporeal creatures. No save, SR applies, lasts 1 round/level (dismissible). Requires a fish tooth as a material component.

name: Wall of Water

targetAreaEffect.value: A straight wall whose area is up to one 10-ft. square/level (S)

description: Creates a 10-foot-thick vertical wall of fresh or salt water (caster's choice), up to one 10-ft square per level, which forms around any creatures or objects in its area, submerging them. A creature in the area may attempt a Reflex save to move to either side before the wall fully forms (must act on its next turn or take full effect). Creatures can cross the wall via Swim checks or by walking along the floor at half speed through the calm water. Open flames in the area are extinguished, and creatures with the fire subtype take 2d6 damage +1/caster level per round spent partly or wholly within the wall. The transparent wall grants cover against attacks from outside, cannot be destroyed by physical damage or drained away, and any water removed in a container instantly evaporates. Lasts 10 minutes/level; requires a sponge as a material component.

otherPrintings.note: Related but not equivalent — Sandstorm's version has a much shorter 1 round/level duration, no saving throw to avoid entrapment (Swim check instead), and no built-in fire-subtype damage.

name: Wild Runner
description: You take on the form and many traits of a centaur: your type becomes monstrous humanoid, size becomes Large with a centaur's space and reach (10 ft/5 ft), and you gain a centaur's average ability scores (Str 18, Dex 14, Con 15) while keeping your own mental scores. Base land speed becomes 50 feet, and you gain darkvision 60 ft. You retain your own extraordinary, spell-like, and supernatural abilities, gain the advantages of a quadruped (greater carrying capacity, +4 bonus to resist trip attacks, ability to fight effectively while carrying a rider), and can still use equipment and cast spells normally. Personal range, lasts 10 minutes/level (dismissible).

name: Wind at Back

targetAreaEffect.value: One creature/level, no two of which are more than 30 ft. apart

description: Doubles the overland speed of you and up to one creature per caster level (no two more than 30 feet apart) traveling together in the same direction, including mounts and pack animals, for 12 hours. Does not affect nonliving material or tactical (combat) speed. Fortitude negates and SR applies, but the effect is harmless.

name: Wings of Air, Greater
description: Functions like wings of air, except the target's flight maneuverability improves by two grades instead of one (clumsy to average, poor to good, or average to perfect). Touch range, harmless, lasts 1 minute/level.

name: Wood Rot

targetAreaEffect.value: One nonmagical wooden object or a volume of wood; or one plant creature

description: A touch instantly destroys any unattended nonmagical wooden object smaller than 6 feet in diameter, or a 3-ft-radius volume of a larger wooden object such as a door. In combat, you can make a melee touch attack to sunder a wooden or wooden-hafted weapon, destroying it (or its wooden part) on a hit; this provokes attacks of opportunity as normal, and the spell has no effect on a weapon that strikes you even if you held the charge. Against wooden shields or armor too large to destroy outright, a successful melee touch attack imposes a -1d6 penalty to their bonus, rendering them unusable if the penalty exceeds the bonus; any attack against a wooden object discharges the spell, and wooden magic items are immune. Against plant creatures, a successful melee touch attack instead deals 3d6 damage +1/caster level (max +15); against such targets the spell lasts 1 round/level, allowing one touch attack per round, but once used offensively against a plant creature it can no longer be used to destroy wooden items. Requires a live termite as a material component.

name: Anticold Sphere
description: Creates a 10-ft-radius emanation centered on you. All creatures within gain immunity to cold damage, and the emanation hedges out (prevents entry by) any creature with the cold subtype, applied at the moment of casting. Lasts 10 minutes/level (dismissible); no save, SR applies.

name: Bite of the Weretiger
description: You gain a +12 enhancement bonus to Strength, +4 to Dexterity, +6 to Constitution, and +5 to natural armor. Your hands become claws (two claw attacks at full base attack bonus) and your mouth becomes a tiger's, adding a bite attack at a -2 penalty (as with Multiattack). Each claw deals 1d8 damage (1d6 if you are Small) plus Str modifier; the bite deals 2d6 damage plus half your Str modifier. You also gain the benefits of the Blind-Fight and Power Attack feats. If your base attack bonus is +6 or higher, you gain no additional attacks. Personal range, lasts 1 round/level; requires a tiger's claw as a material component.

name: Cloak of the Sea
description: Touch spell: while underwater, the subject gains the effects of blur, freedom of movement, and water breathing, and takes no nonlethal damage for the duration. While out of the water (even partially), only the water breathing benefit applies. The subject can move in and out of water freely without ending the spell. Lasts 1 hour/level (dismissible); Will negates and SR applies, but the effect is harmless.

name: Cold Snap
description: A 1-minute casting creates a powerful cold front over a 1-mile-radius circle centered on the caster, lasting 2d4 hours. Temperature drops 5°F per caster level (maximum 50°F drop), to a minimum low of −20°F (see Cold Dangers, DMG 302). Any spell with the cold descriptor cast within the area deals an extra 1 point of damage per die.

name: Contagion, Mass
description: A standard-action spell affecting a 20-ft.-radius spread at medium range. Functions exactly like contagion (PH 213), except every creature within the area is infected rather than a single target. Fortitude negates; spell resistance applies.

name: Dance of the Unicorn
description: A standard action creates a purifying, swirling mist in a 5-ft./level-radius emanation centered on the caster, lasting 1 minute/level (dismissible). Nonmagical contaminants, including inhaled poisons, are automatically negated within the mist, and everyone inside gains a +4 bonus on saves against magical or supernatural gas effects (such as acid fog, cloudkill, or dragon breath). The mist leaves everything in its area damp. No save, no spell resistance.

name: Dire Hunger
description: The target becomes maddened with hunger, viewing all living creatures as food. It gains a bite attack scaled to its size (Fine 1, Diminutive 1d2, Tiny 1d3, Small 1d4, Medium 1d6, Large 1d8, Huge 2d6, Gargantuan 2d8, Colossal 4d6, plus 1.5x Str bonus, or its existing bite if better) and can take no other actions besides that bite attack and defending itself. It relentlessly moves to attack the nearest living creature, routing around hazards or switching targets if a closer creature appears, and keeps hunting until no living creature is detectable.

name: Echo Skull
description: A standard-action, touch spell (focus: a tiny dried animal skull) lasting 1 hour/level (dismissible). The caster can see, hear, and speak through the skull at any distance, as long as caster and skull remain on the same plane, and can switch perception between the skull's location and their own as a free action on their turn. Spell resistance applies to the object.

name: Fireward
description: A standard-action spell covering one 20-ft. cube per level at medium range, lasting 1 hour/level. Functions like quench (PH 267), but additionally suppresses all magical fire effects within its area (similar to an antimagic field, but affecting only fire), and immediately extinguishes any nonmagical fire created in or brought into the area. No save, no spell resistance.

name: Heal Animal Companion
description: A standard-action, touch spell that functions exactly like heal (PH 239), except it can only target the caster's own animal companion. Instantaneous; Will negates (harmless); spell resistance applies (harmless).

name: Ice Flowers
description: A standard-action, instantaneous spell with a 20-ft.-radius burst at long range (Reflex half, no SR). The point of origin must be on the ground; it has no effect in desert terrain or on solid stone. Ground moisture freezes into ice under a layer of soil that bursts violently, turning the ground into rubble terrain (DMG 90) and dealing 1d6 points of damage per caster level (maximum 15d6), half of which is cold damage.

name: Inferno
savingThrow: Fortitude negates and Reﬂex partial; see text
description: A standard-action, close-range spell (material: a gob of beeswax) targeting one creature for up to 6 rounds. The target takes 6d6 points of fire damage unless it succeeds on a Fortitude save; in each subsequent round the fire deals 1d6 less damage (minimum 1d6) until the spell ends or the flames are extinguished. Flammable nonmagical items the target carries automatically fail their saves against this damage. After the first round, the target can spend a full-round action for a DC 15 Reflex save to extinguish the flames (rolling prone grants +2 on this save); jumping into a large body of water or magically extinguishing the fire also ends the effect immediately. Spell resistance applies.

otherPrintings.note: Related but not fully identical — this printing specifies the material component (a gob of beeswax) and a fixed 6-round duration, while the Player's Guide to Faerûn version's duration is stated as 1 round/level (dismissible) with no material specified.

name: Jungle’s Rapture
description: A standard-action, close-range curse (Will negates, SR yes) targeting one living nonplant creature, with permanent duration (dismissible). The target immediately takes 1d6 points of Dexterity drain as its flesh begins hardening into wood, and takes an additional 1d6 points of Dexterity drain each subsequent day the curse remains, even if earlier drain is restored. Once drained to 0 Dexterity, the victim transforms into a normal plant of its original size, with no Int, Wis, or Cha scores (though it radiates a transmutation aura). Being a curse, it cannot be dispelled; it can be removed by break enchantment, limited wish, miracle, or wish, or by remove curse only if that spell's caster level is equal to or higher than the caster's level when jungle's rapture was cast.

name: Mantle of the Icy Soul
description: A standard-action, touch spell (material: a pinch of sapphire dust worth 10 gp) lasting 1 hour/level (Will negates, SR yes). The subject gains the cold subtype, becoming immune to cold but vulnerable to fire (taking half again as much damage from fire effects). If the subject already has the fire subtype, it does not gain the cold subtype but instead loses its fire subtype for the duration.

name: Memory Rot
description: A standard-action, close-range spell (Fortitude negates, SR yes) that creates a cloud of spores infesting a living target's brain. It deals 1d6 points of Intelligence damage immediately, then 1 point of Intelligence drain each round thereafter at the start of the caster's turn. The subject may attempt a new Fortitude save each round; a success halts further Intelligence drain.

name: Owl’s Insight
description: A standard-action, touch spell lasting 1 hour that grants the subject an insight bonus to Wisdom equal to half the caster's level. Fortitude negates (harmless); spell resistance applies (harmless).

name: Panacea
description: A standard-action, touch, instantaneous spell (Will half, harmless; SR yes, harmless) that channels positive energy to cure a creature's afflictions. It immediately ends the following conditions: blinded, confused, dazed, dazzled, deafened, diseased, exhausted, fatigued, frightened, nauseated, panicked, paralyzed, shaken, sickened, and stunned. It also negates sleep effects and the feeblemind spell, ends any ongoing poison effects (as neutralize poison), and cures 1d8 points of damage plus 1 per caster level (maximum +20). It does not remove ability damage, negative levels, or drained levels. Used against an undead creature, it instead deals that same damage (half on a successful Will save) with no other effect.

name: Phantom Stag
description: A standard-action spell (range 0 ft.) that conjures a Large, corporeal, quasi-real staglike mount lasting 1 hour/level (dismissible). It has AC 20 (−1 size, +6 natural armor, +5 Dex), 40 hp + 5 hp per caster level, and attacks with its antlers at +10 for 1d8+9 damage (doubled on a charge). It can trample Medium or smaller creatures, who take 1d6+9 damage unless they succeed on a Reflex save (DC 18 + 1/2 caster level). Speed is 20 ft. per caster level (max 300 ft.); it can carry its rider plus 10 lb. per caster level in gear, and ignores difficult terrain like undergrowth, rubble, or mud. It gains additional abilities by caster level (cumulative): at 12th, at-will air walk usable for up to 1 round at a time (then it falls) and +2 deflection to AC; at 14th, a fly speed (average maneuverability) and +4 deflection; at 16th, its antlers gain the ghost touch and wounding weapon properties and +6 deflection; at 18th, it can use etherealness on behalf of its rider (as the spell, caster level 18th) and +8 deflection.

name: Plant Body
description: A standard-action, personal spell lasting 10 minutes/level with no save or spell resistance. The caster gains plant-type traits: any spell or effect that would affect plant creatures affects the caster instead, and the caster becomes immune to extra damage from critical hits, mind-affecting effects, poison, sleep, paralysis, stunning, and polymorphing. Ability scores, skills, and feats are unaffected, though the new form may make some difficult or impossible to use.

name: Poison Thorns
description: A standard-action, personal spell (material: a dried black rose) lasting 1 round/level (dismissible), with no save or spell resistance. It functions like thornskin (p. 219), except a scratch from the thorns delivers poison to any attacker; a creature grappling the caster is exposed each round at the start of the caster's turn. The poison deals 1d4 points of Strength damage immediately and another 1d4 points of Strength damage 1 minute later, with each instance negated by a separate Fortitude save (DC 10 + 1/2 caster level + Wisdom modifier).

name: Quill Blast
description: A standard-action, instantaneous spell (material: a porcupine quill) that fires needle-sharp quills outward in a 20-ft.-radius spread centered on the caster. Creatures in the area are struck by a number of quills based on size: Tiny or smaller take 4, Small take 6, Medium take 8, Large take 10, Huge or larger take 12. A successful Reflex save halves the quills for Small or larger creatures, and lets Tiny or smaller creatures avoid them entirely. Each quill deals 1d6 points of damage and lodges in the target, imposing a noncumulative −1 penalty on attack rolls, saves, and checks. All lodged quills can be safely removed as a standard action with a DC 20 Heal check; otherwise, removing them deals an extra 1d6 points of damage. Spell resistance applies.

name: Rejuvenation Cocoon
description: A standard-action, touch spell (material: a butterfly's cocoon) that encases a willing creature in a cocoon of force for 2 rounds. One round after forming, it heals the subject 10 points of damage per caster level (maximum 150) and purges poison and disease. At the end of the second round, the cocoon dissipates and the subject is freed to act normally; while cocooned the subject cannot move from its space. The cocoon has hardness 10 and 10 hit points per caster level, and destroying it ends the spell early. Will negates (harmless); spell resistance applies (harmless).

name: Sirine’s Grace
description: A standard-action, personal spell (material: a shard of mirror) lasting 1 round/level, with no save or spell resistance. The caster gains a +4 enhancement bonus to Charisma and Dexterity, a deflection bonus to AC equal to their Charisma modifier, and a +8 bonus on Perform checks. They also gain a swim speed of 60 feet, the ability to breathe water, and can move and attack normally underwater, even with slashing or bludgeoning weapons.

name: Stone Shape, Greater

targetAreaEffect.value: Stone or stone objects touched, up to 10 cu. ft. + 10 cu. ft./ level 208

description: Functions like stone shape (PH), letting you sculpt touched stone or stone objects into any shape you desire, but affects a much larger quantity: up to 10 cu. ft. + 10 cu. ft./level. Instantaneous, no save, no SR.

name: Swamp Stride
duration: 1 hour/level or until expended; see text
description: Functions like tree stride (PH), but you travel between pools of water instead of trees: you sense the nearest pool and other similarly deep pools, then can dive into one and emerge from another as if linked by a tunnel. Each pool must be at least 1 foot deep, the exit pool's depth must be within 1 foot of the entry pool's, and each jump has a maximum range of 500 feet (unlike tree stride). Lasts 1 hour/level or until you've made all your jumps.

name: Vigor, Greater
description: Functions like lesser vigor, but grants the touched creature fast healing 4 for 10 rounds + 1 round/level (maximum 35 rounds). Will negates (harmless), SR yes (harmless).

name: Wall of Sand

targetAreaEffect.value: A straight wall whose area is up to one 10-ft. square/level (S)

description: Conjures a 10-foot-thick, opaque, immobile wall of swirling sand (up to one 10-ft. square/level) that must rest on a solid surface. It blocks ranged attacks with normal cover, but creatures can force their way through with a full-round action and a Strength check, moving 5 feet for every 5 points the check exceeds 10. Creatures inside the wall are blinded, deafened, and unable to speak or breathe (risking suffocation). Spells with verbal components can't be cast inside, and any other spell requires a Concentration check (DC 20 + spell level). Creatures with reach can attack through the wall, but targets have total concealment and cover. Any unprotected open flame pushed into the wall is extinguished instantly. Material component: a handful of sand.

otherPrintings.note: Related but not equivalent — Sandstorm's version is a semi-solid barrier that can be forced through with a Strength check plus a Fortitude save to avoid blindness, versus this version's opaque, sense-blocking effect that also blocks verbal spellcasting.

Nearly identical to this printing but with a smaller area (one 5-ft. square/level vs. one 10-ft. square/level here) and an easier Strength check threshold to force through (exceeding 15 vs. exceeding 10 here).

name: Wind Tunnel
description: Calls up a favorable wind that grants each of up to one creature/level within range a +5 competence bonus on ranged attacks and doubles the range increment of their ranged weapons, for 1 round/level. Fortitude negates (harmless), SR yes (harmless).

name: Anger of the Noonday Sun

targetAreaEffect.value: All sighted creatures within a 20-ft.-radius burst centered on you

description: Your body erupts with radiance in a 20-ft.-radius burst centered on you. Any creature that can see you must save or be blinded for 1 minute/caster level. Undead in the area take 1d6 damage per two caster levels (max 10d6), or half on a successful Reflex save; if it fails its save and is the type specifically harmed by bright light (such as a vampire), it is destroyed outright. Fungi, molds, oozes, and slimes are affected the same way as undead. SR applies.

name: Animate Snow

targetAreaEffect.value: Cube of snow up to 20 ft. on a side

description: Turns snow in the target area into 1d3+2 Large animated objects, 1d3 Huge animated objects, or one Gargantuan animated object, obeying your vocal commands for 1 round/level. The animated snow has no hardness score, moves at 30 ft. as if it had legs, has the blind special quality, and has the cold subtype, dealing an extra 1d6 cold damage on a hit. It takes 1d6 damage per round if the ambient temperature is above freezing.

name: Aspect of the Earth Hunter
description: You take on the physical form of a bulette for 10 minutes/level (D): type becomes magical beast, size Huge (15 ft./10 ft. space/reach), Str 27/Dex 15/Con 20 (retaining your own mental scores), land speed 40 ft., burrow speed 10 ft., darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent, and tremorsense 60 ft. Class, level, hp, alignment, BAB, and base save bonuses stay the same; you keep extraordinary abilities tied to class levels but lose other Ex, Su, and Sp abilities from your normal form, and can't speak or cast spells unless you have Natural Spell. Natural armor becomes +12 regardless of your normal form's. You get two claw attacks dealing 2d8+8 each, or four claws instead of two using the bulette's leap ability. Equipment melds into the new form and stops functioning. Material component: a piece of bulette shell.

name: Bite of the Werebear
description: You partially transform into a bear-hybrid for 1 round/level, gaining +16 Str, +2 Dex, +8 Con, and +7 natural armor (all enhancement bonuses), plus two claw attacks and a bite attack. Both claws attack at your full attack bonus; the bite takes a -2 penalty (as with Multiattack). Each claw deals 1d8 (1d6 if Small) + Str mod; the bite deals 2d8 (2d6 if Small) + 1/2 Str mod. You also gain the benefits of Blind-Fight and Power Attack. If your base attack bonus is +6 or higher, you gain no additional iterative attacks. Material component: a tuft of bear fur.

name: Blood Sirocco

targetAreaEffect.value: Cone-shaped emanation centered on you or on a point in space

description: A windstorm-force wind blasts from you in a 60-ft. cone for 1 round/level. Small or smaller creatures are knocked prone and rolled 1d4×10 feet, taking 1d4 nonlethal damage per 10 feet rolled; Medium creatures are knocked prone; Large or Huge creatures simply can't move toward the point of origin. A successful Fortitude save lets a creature move normally that round. Each round a living creature fails its save, it also takes 2 points of damage from dehydration. The wind automatically extinguishes unprotected flames and has a 50% chance to extinguish protected flames (which otherwise dance wildly). The wind keeps blowing for the duration, offering a new save each round.

name: Cometfall
description: A comet plummets onto the target area, dealing 1d6 damage per caster level (max 15d6) to everything in a 5-ft.-radius burst; a failed Reflex save also knocks the creature prone, while a successful save halves the damage and avoids being knocked down. The comet leaves a 10-foot-square area filled with dense rubble on impact. You must have at least 40 feet of vertical space above the impact point, or the spell fails.

name: Dinosaur Stampede
description: Spectral stampeding dinosaurs sweep through a 20-ft.-radius spread for 1 round/level (D), dealing 1d12 damage + 1/caster level (max +20) to creatures within, Reflex half; creatures more than 10 feet above the ground are unaffected. As a free action you can shift the effect's point of origin up to 40 feet along the ground each round. A creature can't be damaged more than once per round by the spell. SR applies. Material component: a fossil.

name: Drown
description: Targets one living creature (Fortitude negates); fills its lungs with water, triggering the drowning rules as though it had failed to hold its breath. Its hit points immediately drop to 0 and it falls unconscious; the next round it drops to -1 hp and is dying; the round after that it dies. The victim cannot expel the water on its own, but another creature can stabilize it with a DC 15 Heal check before it dies. Undead, constructs, creatures that don't need to breathe, and water-breathers are unaffected. Instantaneous, SR applies.

name: Energy Immunity
description: Grants a touched creature and its gear complete immunity to hit point damage from one energy type (acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic) for 24 hours. It blocks only hp damage, so side effects like drowning in acid, being deafened by sonic, or being immobilized in ice can still occur. While active, it supersedes protection from energy and resist energy, which absorb no damage as long as this spell lasts. SR yes (harmless).

name: Enveloping Cocoon

targetAreaEffect.value: Cocoon of force around one Large or smaller creature

description: Encases one Large or smaller creature (Reflex negates) in a cocoon of force for 1 round/level (D) or until destroyed. The cocoon has hardness 10 and 10 hp/caster level. The trapped creature can't move or cast spells with somatic components, and can only attack the cocoon itself, using natural or light weapons. You may cast a second spell at the cocoon to attach it; when the cocoon's duration ends or it's dismissed, the attached spell automatically affects the trapped creature with no save (though SR still applies) — but if the cocoon is destroyed first, the attached spell is wasted. Compatible attachable spells include infestation of maggots, languor, miasma, and phantasmal disorientation, as well as baleful polymorph, blight, contagion, dominate animal, flame strike, and poison (for poison, the subject automatically fails the initial save but can still attempt the secondary one). Material component: a live caterpillar. SR applies.

name: Extract Water Elemental
description: Forcibly extracts the moisture from one living creature's body through its eyes, nose, mouth, and pores, dealing 1d6 damage per caster level (max 20d6), Fortitude half. If the target is slain by this damage, the extracted water coalesces into a water elemental sized to match the slain creature (up to Huge), under your control as though summoned, which vanishes after 1 minute. Has no effect on creatures with the fire subtype. SR applies.

name: Fires of Purity
description: The touched creature bursts into harmless magical flame for 1 round/level. Its successful melee attacks deal an extra 1 fire damage per caster level (max +15; SR applies to this extra damage). Any creature that successfully hits the subject in melee (without a reach weapon) takes that same extra fire damage. The subject also takes only half damage from fire-based attacks, and no damage at all if such an attack allows a Reflex save for half and the subject succeeds.

name: Freeze
description: Fires a ray requiring a ranged touch attack; a hit deals 2d6 cold damage, and unless the target succeeds on a Reflex save, it becomes encased in a thick ice sheath and immobilized (helpless), taking 2d6 cold damage each round while encased. An encased creature is aware and breathes normally but can't speak or move except to try to escape with a DC 22 Strength check; it can still take purely mental actions (like using spell-like abilities) or cast spells with no verbal/somatic components if the material/focus is already in hand. The ice blocks line of effect, causes flying creatures to fall, and lets swimmers float to the surface without swimming. The ice itself has hardness 0 and 15 hp and can be attacked by others to free the target; damage to a target must first destroy the ice. The ice melts when the spell's duration (1 round/2 levels) ends. Reflex partial, SR applies.

name: Hide the Path
range: Anywhere in the area to be warded
description: Wards a continuous area of up to 200 sq. ft./caster level (up to 20 feet high, shaped as desired) against divination magic for 24 hours (D). Find the path fails to function in the warded area, and any caster attempting a 1st- through 6th-level divination spell there must succeed on a caster level check (DC 11 + your caster level) or the spell fails; higher-level divinations work normally, and divinations cast from outside the area are unaffected. Focus: a 6-inch onyx sphere on an obsidian stand worth at least 1,000 gp; anyone touching the focus can cast divinations freely, and destroying or removing the focus from the warded area immediately dismisses the spell.

name: Hungry Gizzard
description: A Large fleshy mass engulfs one Medium or smaller target within range unless it succeeds on a Reflex save (in which case the gizzard vanishes harmlessly). While trapped, the creature is grappled and takes 2d8+8 crushing damage plus 1d8 acid damage each round, starting the round the spell is cast. It can cast spells only if they lack somatic components, it has the material components in hand, and it succeeds on a Concentration check (DC 20 + spell level). It can cut its way out with claws or a light slashing weapon by dealing 25 damage to the gizzard (AC 12 from inside); from outside the gizzard has AC 4. The gizzard has 5 hp/caster level, is treated as an unattended object for saves, and is destroyed at 0 hp, melting into a pool of blood and gore when the creature escapes or it is destroyed. Lasts 1 round/level (D). Material component: a dried gizzard.

name: Miasma
description: Fills the target's mouth and throat with unbreathable gas. The subject can't speak, cast verbal spells, use breath weapons, or speak command words, though it can otherwise act normally. It can hold its breath for 2 rounds per point of Constitution, then must make a Constitution check (DC 10 + 1 per previous success) each round to keep holding it. Failure (or voluntarily breathing) knocks it unconscious at 0 hp; the next round it drops to -1 hp and is dying; the round after, it suffocates.

name: Phantasmal Disorientation
description: Ranged illusion that makes the ground and landscape around the target seem to shift (Will negates; SR yes). On casting, the target makes a Will save: success means it moves and acts normally; failure means its movement veers 90 degrees to one side (50/50 chance either way) and it cannot target anything with ranged attacks or ranged spells. The subject doesn't realize it's off course until it meaningfully interacts with its surroundings (e.g., attacking or handling an object). For the full duration (1 minute/level), the affected creature must succeed on a Will save each round to move normally. Only movement direction and ranged attacks are affected; melee attacks, personal/touch spells, and other actions work normally.

name: Resistance, Superior
description: Functions like the spell resistance (PH), except the touched subject gains a +6 resistance bonus on saving throws instead. Duration 24 hours (Will negates harmless; SR yes harmless).

name: Stonehold
description: Conjures stony arms hidden beneath rock or stone in the area (one 10-ft. square/level, one arm per square) that spring up when a creature passes near. A creature entering the area must succeed on a Reflex save or be immobilized (it can still act, just can't move); creatures that start their turn in the area must save again. Held creatures take 1d6+5 damage each round at the start of the caster's turn. A held creature can break free with a DC 20 Strength check, a DC 25 Escape Artist check, or by destroying the arm (AC 15, hardness 8, 15 hp). The arms stay hidden until they attack and can be found (but not disarmed) like a trap. Duration 24 hours/level; SR yes (object).

name: Summon Greater Elemental
description: 1-round casting summons a greater air, earth, fire, or water elemental (caster's choice) from its home plane, appearing where designated and acting immediately on the caster's turn. It understands the caster regardless of language and obeys commands (a free action) to the best of its ability. Lasts as long as the caster concentrates, up to 1 round/level + 1 round. No save, no SR. The spell's type matches the element summoned.

name: Tidal Surge

targetAreaEffect.value: One creature or all creatures in a 20-ft.-radius burst

description: Instantaneous water attack, Reflex half, SR yes. If no large natural water source is within range, it can only strike a single target; if one exists, it instead creates a 20-ft.-radius burst centered on a chosen point. Deals 1d6 damage per caster level (max 15d6) to the target(s)/creatures in the burst. Affected creatures also suffer a bull rush via an opposed Strength check (the water gets +5, or +10 if cast near a natural water source); those who lose are pushed 5 ft. in the caster-chosen direction, plus 5 ft. for every 5 points the check is beaten by, potentially into water. The wave extinguishes unprotected open flames of Large size or smaller in its path/area, and has a 50% chance versus protected flames; if it hits a magical fire, that fire is subjected to a dispel magic effect as though the caster cast it.

name: Tortoise Shell
description: Touch spell (harmless, SR yes) lasting 10 minutes/level that grants the subject a +6 enhancement bonus to its natural armor (treating no natural armor as +0), increasing by 1 for every 3 caster levels beyond 11th, to a maximum of +9 at 20th level. Stacks with natural armor but not with other enhancement bonuses to natural armor. It slows the subject's movement as though wearing heavy armor, though it does not impose an armor check penalty or arcane spell failure chance.

name: Vigorous Circle

targetAreaEffect.value: One creature/2 levels, no two of which are more than 30 ft. apart

description: Functions exactly like mass lesser vigor, except it also grants fast healing 3. Targets one creature/2 levels within 30 ft. of each other; duration 10 rounds + 1 round/level (max 40); Will negates (harmless), SR yes (harmless).

name: Aura of Vitality

targetAreaEffect.value: One creature/3 levels, no two of which are more than 30 ft. apart

description: Grants one creature per 3 caster levels (all within 30 ft. of each other) a +4 morale bonus to Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution for 1 round/level. Will negates (harmless); SR yes (harmless).

name: Brilliant Blade

targetAreaEffect.value: One melee or thrown weapon, or ﬁfty projectiles (all of which must be in contact with each other at the time of casting)

description: Turns a single melee, natural, or thrown weapon — or a group of up to fifty projectiles touching each other — into a weapon with the brilliant energy special ability (DMG) for 1 minute/level. If cast on arrows or crossbow bolts, the effect on any individual projectile ends after one use, whether or not it hits its target; shuriken are treated as arrows (single-use) rather than as thrown weapons for this purpose. Will negates (harmless, object); SR yes (harmless, object).

name: Cloud-walkers
description: Each subject can fly at speed 60 ft. (perfect maneuverability) but only outdoors, walking on gaseous pads of cloudstuff. A subject can end the effect on itself with a standard action to shake off the cloudstuff and touch down; you can also dismiss the spell, but only for all subjects simultaneously.

name: Master Earth
description: Personal, instantaneous transmutation: the caster sinks into the ground and travels instantly through earth and stone to a chosen destination anywhere on the same world, with no distance limit. If the caster doesn't picture an exact location, they arrive at the edge of the general area imagined. The earth always deposits the caster back on the surface, getting as close to the destination as possible even if it can't reach it exactly; underground structures don't block the caster as long as they can be moved around. Works only on the Material Plane. Focus: the fossil of any animal.

name: Shifting Paths
description: 10-minute casting that hides an existing path or road within range while simultaneously creating an illusory path starting from a chosen point within range and running in a chosen direction across the spell's area (1-mile radius + 1 mile/level), ending abruptly at the area's edge. The illusory path avoids obstacles and offers no bridges, stairs, or similar aids, and can never be forced over a cliff or across water deeper than 4 ft. Creatures that fail a Will save (made when they interact with the paths) follow the illusory path, mistaking any terrain-based speed reduction for a slope; those who succeed see both paths, with the illusory one appearing shadowy and clearly unreal. Duration 1 hour/level; SR yes.

name: Slime Wave
description: Creates a wave of green slime (DMG) that erupts from a chosen point and spreads violently to fill a 15-ft.-radius spread (Reflex negates, no SR), splashing onto nearby walls and ceilings. The slime devours flesh, organic material, and even metal on contact; each creature in the area is coated with one patch. Unlike ordinary green slime, this slime gradually evaporates and is gone by the end of the duration (1 round/level). Material component: a few drops of stagnant pond water.

name: Storm Tower
description: 1-round casting creates a cylinder of storm clouds and howling wind (20-ft. radius, 100 ft. high, 1 round/level, dismissible). It absorbs electricity damage dealt to anyone inside, and magic missile cannot be cast into, out of, or within it. The interior has windstorm-strength winds, making ranged attacks impossible inside (movement is unaffected). Only Gargantuan or Colossal creatures can pass through its edge freely; smaller creatures must succeed on a Fortitude save to enter or are stopped at the boundary. Those inside have concealment from those outside. The winds impose a -10 penalty on Listen checks within 50 ft., including inside the tower. Fortitude negates (see text); SR yes.

name: Storm of Elemental Fury

targetAreaEffect.value: 40-ft.-radius storm cloud, 200 ft. above the ground

description: 1-round casting summons a 40-ft.-radius storm cloud 200 ft. above the ground that produces an escalating effect each round over 4 rounds. Round 1: windstorm-strength winds make ranged attacks impossible in the area; Small or smaller creatures must succeed on a Fortitude save or be blown away, Medium creatures must save or be knocked prone, and Large or larger creatures must save to move that round; flying creatures that fail are instead blown randomly (1d6x5 ft. if Large+, 1d6x10 ft. if Medium, 2d6x10 ft. if Small or smaller); spells cast in the area are disrupted unless the caster beats a Concentration DC equal to this spell's save DC + the spell's level. Round 2: falling rock deals 5d6 damage to everyone in the storm, no save. Round 3: torrential rain extinguishes unprotected flames automatically and protected ones with a 50% chance, cuts visibility to 5 ft., and halves movement. Round 4: falling flame deals 1d6 fire damage per caster level (max 15d6), Reflex half. SR yes.

name: Swamp Lung

targetAreaEffect.value: One living creature with a respiratory system

description: Instantaneous spell (Fortitude negates, no SR) that floods a living target's lungs with stagnant swamp water. A creature that can't breathe water must expel it; success means it's coughed out with little effort. On a failed save, the creature falls prone, helpless, and coughing for 1d6 rounds, and contracts filth fever (DMG). Creatures that can breathe water must still make the Fortitude save to avoid catching the disease, but are otherwise unaffected.

name: Waterspout
description: 1-round casting creates a whirling column of water (5-ft. radius, 80 ft. high, 1 round/level) that the caster can direct as a move action, either controlling it continuously or giving it a simple movement program; it moves 30 ft. during the caster's turn and collapses if it exceeds the spell's range. Any creature or object touching it must succeed on a Reflex save or take 3d8 damage; Medium or smaller creatures that fail are sucked in and take 2d6 damage/round (no save) while trapped for 1d3 rounds, then are ejected from the top and fall back to the surface 1d8x5 ft. from the spout's base, taking 8d6 falling damage. Waterborne creatures or objects within 10 ft. of the spout (below or to the sides) that are Medium or smaller must also make a Reflex save or be sucked in with the same effects. Only very small watercraft (canoes, kayaks, coracles) can be pulled in; their occupants may substitute a Profession (sailor) check for the Reflex save. No SR.

name: Word of Balance

targetAreaEffect.value: Creatures in a 30-ft.-radius spread centered on you

savingThrow: None or Will negates; see text
description: Instantaneous evocation affecting all lawful good, chaotic good, lawful evil, and chaotic evil creatures within a 30-ft.-radius spread centered on the caster who hear the word (no save, SR yes, effects cumulative by HD relative to caster level): HD equal to caster level = nauseated (limited to a single move action for 1 round, can still defend); HD up to caster level -1 = weakened (Strength drops 2d6 for 2d4 rounds); HD up to caster level -5 = paralyzed and helpless for 1d10 minutes; HD up to caster level -10 = killed (destroyed if undead). Creatures with more HD than the caster's level are unaffected. If cast on the caster's home plane, every qualifying lawful/chaotic good or evil elemental and outsider in the area is banished to its home plane (Will save at -4 negates) and cannot return for at least 24 hours, regardless of whether it actually heard the word; those that did hear it also suffer the HD-based effects above.

name: Awaken, Mass

targetAreaEffect.value: One animal or tree/3 levels, no two of which are more than 30 ft. apart

description: 24-hour casting that awakens one animal or tree per 3 caster levels (all of the same kind, no two more than 30 ft. apart) to humanlike sentience. Requires a Will save, DC 10 + the HD of the highest-HD target (or the tree's HD once awakened, whichever is greater); failure means the spell fails for all targets. Awakened creatures become friendly to the caster (no special telepathic bond) and will perform tasks if asked. An awakened tree functions like an animated object (MM) but with Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma each 3d6, and gains the ability to move its limbs/roots/vines and senses similar to a human's. An awakened animal gains 3d6 Intelligence, a +1d3 bonus to Charisma, and +2 HD. Each awakened creature can speak one language the caster knows, plus one more per point of its Intelligence bonus. Costs 250 XP per creature awakened. Duration instantaneous; SR yes (see text).

name: Bombardment
description: Boulders crash down in a 15-ft-radius, 40-ft-high cylinder centered on a point you designate within long range. Creatures in the area that fail a Reflex save take 1d8 points of damage per caster level (maximum 20d8) and are buried under 5 feet of rubble; a successful save halves the damage and avoids burial. A buried creature can free itself with a DC 20 Strength check (a full-round action) or be dug out by others (1 minute for a lone rescuer); while buried it can't move, can't cast spells with somatic components, and must have material components in hand. After casting, the area is left covered in 5 feet of dense rubble (DMG 90). Focus: a quartz crystal embedded in rock.

otherPrintings.note: Related but not fully identical — this printing specifies a 40-ft.-high cylinder, a fixed 5 ft. of rubble, and a DC 20 Strength check to dig free; the Player's Guide to Faerûn version leaves burial depth and escape DC unstated, describing only a full-round action to climb out.

name: Brilliant Aura

targetAreaEffect.value: Weapons carried by one creature/2 levels, no two of which are more than 30 ft. apart

description: Functions like brilliant blade, except it affects one creature per 2 caster levels within close range (no two more than 30 ft apart), and all weapons carried by the subjects gain the brilliant energy special ability for the spell's duration (1 round/level). Harmless; Will negates, SR yes (harmless).

name: Cocoon
description: Cast on a corpse (dead no less than 1 round per caster level), this spell wraps the body in silk threads, preserving it and beginning a slow rebirth process; Fortitude negates. If the corpse is raised, resurrected, or reincarnated at any point during the next week, the creature suffers no level or Constitution loss normally associated with such spells. If not returned to life by the end of the week, the creature is automatically reincarnated (as reincarnate), with no loss of level or Constitution. Material component: a silkworm cocoon. XP cost: 250.

name: Deadfall

targetAreaEffect.value: Mass of dead wood forming in a cylinder (20-ft. radius, 40 ft. high); see text

description: A huge, roaring tangle of logs and branches erupts and collapses within a 20-ft-radius, 40-ft-high cylinder centered on a point you choose within long range. Creatures and objects in the area take 1d6 points of damage per caster level (maximum 20d6), and creatures in the area must succeed on a Reflex save or be knocked prone. Afterward, a 5-foot-high pile of brush with a 20-foot radius remains, counting as dense rubble (DMG 90).

name: Maelstrom

targetAreaEffect.value: A whirlpool 120 ft. wide and 60 ft. deep

description: Creates a deadly vortex in a body of water at least 120 feet wide and 60 feet deep (otherwise the spell is wasted). Waterborne creatures or objects within 50 feet of the vortex must succeed on a Reflex save (or a Swim check instead, if higher than their Reflex bonus) or be sucked in, taking 3d8 points of damage; vessels avoid being pulled in if their operator succeeds on a Profession (sailor) check against the same DC. Once inside, victims take 3d8 points of bludgeoning damage each round at the start of your turn and remain trapped for 2d4 rounds, then are ejected to a square adjacent to the vortex's bottom (Large or smaller subjects) or top (larger subjects), with a new Reflex save to avoid being sucked back in. Duration 1 round/level; no SR.

name: Phantom Wolf
description: Conjures one incorporeal Large magical beast phantom wolf that fights on your behalf, acting on your turn, for up to 1 round/level as long as you concentrate and it stays within medium range (100 ft + 10 ft/level); line of effect isn't required after casting, but the spell ends if the wolf ever leaves range. Stat block: Init +9; AC 25, touch 25, flat-footed 16; hp 113 (12 HD); Fort +12, Ref +17, Will +7; fly 60 ft. (good); bite +22 incorporeal touch (2d6 plus 3d6 cold); frightful presence (30-ft. radius, Will DC 24 negates, frightens creatures with fewer than 12 HD for 3d6 rounds, 24-hour immunity on a successful save); feats Alertness, Combat Reflexes, Dodge, Mobility, Weapon Focus (bite). No saving throw or SR against the summoning itself.

name: Red Tide
description: A wave of thick red seawater washes over a 30-ft-radius burst, knocking every creature in the area prone and forcing a Fortitude save. Success: sickened for 1 minute. Failure: nauseated for 1 minute and 2d6 points of Strength damage; after the minute, the creature must make a second Fortitude save or take another 2d6 points of Strength damage. Creatures immune to poison are immune to these effects. Creatures with the fire subtype additionally take 1d6 points of damage per caster level (maximum 20d6), half on a successful Reflex save. The water vanishes almost immediately, leaving nothing wet.

name: Stormrage
description: Personal buff lasting 1 minute/level. You gain a fly speed of 40 feet, immunity to thrown weapons and projectile ranged attacks, and total immunity to the adverse effects of natural or magical wind. As a standard action that doesn't provoke attacks of opportunity, once per round you can fire a ranged touch electricity bolt from your eyes (100-ft. range, SR applies, no save): +3 bonus on the attack roll if the target is wearing metal armor, made of metal, or carrying a lot of metal, dealing 1d6 points of electricity damage per two caster levels (maximum 10d6).

name: Unyielding Roots
description: Touch a willing creature that is standing on or touching the ground; for 1 round/level it can't move from its space, nor be moved by bull rushes, overruns, forceful hand-type effects, or anything short of a massive earthquake (such attempts simply fail). If overrun, the rooted creature automatically wins the Strength check to stop it and can make an opposed Strength check to knock the attacker prone instead. The roots also heal up to 30 points of damage per round, automatically neutralize poison, and remove negative levels as restoration. The subject gains a +4 bonus on Fortitude and Will saves but takes a −4 penalty on Reflex saves while rooted. Harmless; Fortitude negates, SR yes (harmless).

name: Cast in Stone
savingThrow: None and Fortitude negates; see text
description: A personal gaze attack (30-ft. range, 1 round/level duration): any creature that meets your gaze is permanently turned into a mindless, inert statue (as flesh to stone) unless it succeeds on a Fortitude save. You can free a victim at any time by speaking a command word set during casting. Each affected creature must save each round at the start of its turn; averting its eyes grants it a 50% chance to avoid the gaze but gives you concealment against it, while closing its eyes or turning away entirely avoids the gaze but grants you total concealment from that creature. As a standard action each round, you may also actively target one creature within range with the gaze, forcing it to save (the averting/closing-eyes benefits still apply).

name: Death Ward, Mass

targetAreaEffect.value: One creature/ level, no two of which are more than 30 ft. apart

description: Functions like death ward (PH 217), except it affects one creature per level, no two of which can be more than 30 feet apart, within close range. Duration 1 minute/level. Harmless; Will negates, SR yes (harmless).

name: Drown, Mass

targetAreaEffect.value: One or more creatures, no two of which are more than 30 ft. apart.

description: Functions like drown, except it affects one or more creatures, no two of which can be more than 30 feet apart. Instantaneous; Fortitude negates, SR yes.

name: Nature’s Avatar
description: As a swift action, touch an animal ally to grant it, for 1 minute/level, a +10 morale bonus on attack and damage rolls, 1d8 temporary hit points per caster level, and the effects of a haste spell. Harmless; Will negates, SR yes (harmless).

name: Perinarch, Planar

targetAreaEffect.value: A radius of raw Limbo within close range

savingThrow: None (object) and Reflex negates; see text
description: Functions like perinarch, except it can be cast on any highly morphic or divinely morphic plane (DMG 148), not just Limbo.

otherPrintings.note: Planar Handbook itself does not print a target/area line; this entry's target/area is Spell Compendium's addition.

name: Phantom Bear
description: Functions like phantom wolf (page 157), except you conjure an incorporeal bear with a fearsome roar instead of a wolf; same range, duration (concentration, up to 1 round/level), and lack of save or SR.

name: Shadow Landscape

targetAreaEffect.value: One-mile-radius spread centered on a point in space

description: A 1-hour casting that infuses a one-mile-radius area (centered on a point within long range) with power from the Plane of Shadow, making the terrain more dangerous for 24 hours/level. Effects vary by terrain: desert temperature shifts 30 degrees hotter (or colder if it's a tundra) with hourly sand/snowstorms; forest undergrowth thickens and heavy undergrowth entangles as the entangle spell (DC = this spell's DC); hills gain heavy undergrowth and steeper slopes (2 squares of movement uphill on gradual slopes, 4 on steep ones) plus DC 25 Climb cliffs; marshes turn half their undergrowth spaces to quicksand; mountains gain DC 25 Climb cliffs/chasms, a 10% chance per failed Climb check or loud noise of triggering an avalanche, and altitude effects worsened by one category; plains gain frequent storms/tornadoes and half their undergrowth spaces entangle as above; underground, only natural caverns (not dungeons) are affected, with stone floors costing 4 squares of movement per space and stalagmites covering 10% of the floor. The spell also worsens random weather rolls (roll twice and take the higher result, or three times in plains); this doesn't apply underground. You are unaffected by your own spell's terrain effects, and you can designate one creature per four caster levels as a similarly unaffected traveler (still subject to bad weather). You may also designate up to 1 HD of native animals, plants, or magical beasts per caster level as shadow guardians; while within the area they are friendly to you and your travelers and gain (or upgrade to, if weaker) resistance to cold 10, darkvision 60 ft., DR 5/magic, evasion, and low-light vision. Reflex partial, SR yes.

name: Summon Elemental Monolith
description: Summons an elemental monolith (Complete Arcane 156), which appears at a designated spot within medium range and immediately attacks your enemies on your turn as long as you concentrate (up to 1 round/level); directing it is a free action, and if you share its language and are close enough you can command it not to attack, target specific foes, or take other actions. It can't be summoned into an environment hostile to its element, and the spell takes on the air, earth, fire, or water subtype matching the monolith summoned. Material component: a 100 gp gem (aquamarine for air, tourmaline for earth, garnet for fire, or pearl for water).

name: Transmute Rock to Lava
description: Transforms a 10-ft. cube of natural, uncut or unworked rock into an equal volume of molten lava. Creatures in the area who succeed on a Reflex save and can physically escape on their next turn take 6d6 points of fire damage; those who fail the save, or can't escape, take 20d6 points of fire damage each round they remain. While in the lava, speed drops to 5 feet and creatures take a −2 penalty on attack rolls and AC. Even after leaving, exposed creatures take half damage (3d6 or 10d6, matching their prior result) for one additional round. If cast on a cavern or tunnel ceiling, the lava falls and spreads into a 15-ft.-radius, roughly 1.5-ft.-deep pool, dealing 2d6 fire damage (Reflex half) to anyone directly beneath and 10d6 fire damage per round to those caught in the pool. Worked stone can't be targeted directly, but casting on adjacent unworked stone deals 10d6 fire damage per round to a touching structure; wooden structures instantly ignite. The lava stops dealing damage and begins reverting to stone after 2d6 hours, though a pool can take up to two days to fully cool and the core of a 10-ft. cube may stay molten for a month or more. Magical or enchanted stone is unaffected.

name: Tsunami
description: Conjures a towering wave (20 ft./level wide, 10 ft. long, 40 ft. high) that starts at a point within long range and moves 60 feet per round in a direction you choose, unable to change course once set, for up to 1 round/level while you concentrate. It deals 1d6 points of bludgeoning damage per caster level (maximum 20d6) to everything in its path, Fortitude save for half. Gargantuan or larger creatures that fail the save are knocked prone; Huge or smaller creatures that fail are picked up and carried, taking the damage again each round (with a new Fortitude save for half) and unable to move any other way, while suffering a −4 Dexterity penalty and −2 penalty on attack rolls and needing a DC 20 + spell level Concentration check to cast spells. A carried creature can escape with a DC 20 Swim check if it ends its movement outside the wave; a would-be rescuer can extract someone with a DC 20 Strength check if they avoid being swept up themselves. The wave is halted by anything that blocks line of effect along its path (unless destroyed), though a partially blocked wave continues past the obstruction. Cast on open sea rather than land, saves take a −4 penalty and the wave's width increases to 40 ft./caster level; a wave that moves from water onto land immediately shrinks to land size and speed, and the wave persists even if it travels beyond the spell's initial range. Material component: a crown of coral set with pearls worth at least 5,000 gp.

name: Undermaster
description: A 5-round personal effect usable while standing on or beneath the earth's surface. While active, once per round as a standard action (even for spells that normally take longer to cast, such as move earth) you can choose and use one of the following as a spell-like ability: earth lock, earthquake, excavate, flesh to stone, meld into stone, move earth, reverse gravity, soften earth and stone, statue, stone shape, stone tell, stone to flesh, transmute mud to rock, transmute rock to mud, tunnel swallow, wall of stone, and xorn movement. Material component: a deep blue spinel worth 500 gp.

name: Whirlwind, Greater

targetAreaEffect.value: 20-ft.-radius tornado, up to 5 ft./level high, centered on a point in space

description: A more potent version of whirlwind (PH 301): a 20-ft.-radius tornado up to 5 ft./level tall, centered on a point within medium range, lasting 1 round/level. Large or smaller creatures starting their turn within 60 ft. of the center must succeed on a Fortitude save or be dragged 1d4×10 feet toward the center, taking 1d4 points of nonlethal damage per 10 feet dragged. Huge creatures within 40 ft. must save or be knocked prone; Gargantuan and Colossal creatures within 40 ft. must save before moving away. Flying Huge or smaller creatures that fail their save are sucked to the center, taking 2d6 points of damage; Gargantuan flyers that fail are pulled 1d6×10 feet toward the center, Colossal flyers 1d6×5 feet. Any Huge or smaller creature that contacts the tornado must succeed on a Reflex save or take 3d6 points of damage; a Large or smaller creature that fails its first save must succeed on a second or be picked up and held suspended for 3 rounds before being ejected. Creatures that start their turn inside the tornado take 6d6 points of damage each round and cannot attack, cast spells, or move; when ejected, a creature reappears 4d6×5 feet away in a random direction and 4d6×5 feet off the ground (falling immediately if it can't fly). The tornado automatically uproots vegetation, leaves dense rubble in its wake, and deals 2d6×10 points of damage per round to structures (enough to destroy anything less sturdy than reinforced masonry within a round or two). No ranged attacks can pass through it, it extinguishes flames it touches, and Listen checks are impossible within it. It remains stationary unless you direct it as a move action, moving up to 60 feet per round. Fortitude partial, SR yes.
